title: Product & Technical Support Engineer - L1
description:
* **Job Title:**
  Product & Technical Support Engineer - L1
* **Department:**
  Technology Operations
* **Reports To:**
  Tech Support Team Lead
* **Experience:**
  2 to 4 Years
* **Job Location**
  : Client Onsite (Navi Mumbai)

CredAble is seeking a
**Product & Technical Support Engineer – L1**
to serve as the first point of contact for customers using our suite of
**Supply Chain Finance (SCF) products**
. The role combines product and technical support, ensuring customers receive timely and effective assistance for
**product functionality, configurations, application issues and infrastructure-related concerns**
.

The Product & Technical Support Engineer will be based at the
**client’s office location**
and will be responsible for monitoring application and infrastructure services, troubleshooting issues, assisting customers with product features and configurations, and communicating resolutions clearly. Issues requiring deeper technical investigation will be appropriately escalated to the relevant engineering teams and tracked through resolution within defined
**SLAs**
.

The role requires a
**customer-focused approach**
, good technical and problem-solving capabilities, an ability to understand product functionality, and
**strong written and verbal communication skills in English**
.

**Responsibilities**

**Application Support**

* Work in a rotational shift schedule of 9 hours per day, 5 days per week, supporting 24×7×365 operations.
* Work onsite from the client’s office in Navi Mumbai as required for this role.
* Monitor, manage and respond to customer queries, incidents and service requests through the designated case management tool.
* Support customers during User Acceptance Testing (UAT), configuration setup, transaction processing and other product-related activities.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues using established SOPs, product knowledge, technical understanding and business process knowledge, escalating complex issues to the appropriate teams when required.
* Communicate clearly and professionally with customers, both verbally and in writing, ensuring that issues, actions and resolutions are effectively communicated.
* Follow established incident management processes, workflows, escalation procedures and SLAs.
* Investigate and resolve application-related incidents and defects affecting critical business systems.
* Review and analyse application and infrastructure logs to identify root causes and support issue resolution.
* Review, maintain and update SOPs, knowledge articles and relevant technical/product documentation.
* Support ad-hoc projects, operational activities and other assignments as required.

**Infrastructure Support**

* Monitor and support application and infrastructure environments, including Kubernetes, Linux servers, application services, scheduled jobs, queues and related components.
* Perform operational activities including service restarts, log analysis, CPU and memory utilization checks, environment health checks, and application/infrastructure performance monitoring.
* Support production deployments, application releases, infrastructure changes and patch upgrades in coordination with remote SRE and DevOps teams.
* Support VPN, SFTP and network connectivity-related issues, coordinating with relevant Client teams for resolution where required.

**Qualifications**

* Experience: 2–4 years of experience in a product support, technical support or customer-facing technical role.
* Technical Skills: Basic understanding of Java or similar programming languages, RDBMS concepts, SQL queries, and Linux/Unix commands.
* Working or operational knowledge of cloud platforms, preferably AWS.
* Basic understanding of application and infrastructure troubleshooting would be preferred.

**Soft Skills**

* Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills, with a strong focus on delivering a positive and professional customer experience.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain product and technical concepts clearly and concisely.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot technical issues and identify appropriate solutions.
* Familiarity with Supply Chain Finance (SCF) products, workflows and business processes would be an added advantage.
* Prior experience in a customer-facing product or technical support role is preferred.

**Benefits**

* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Opportunities for professional growth and development.
* Collaborative and supportive work environment.

title: Engineer Maritime connectivity support
description:
**Company Description**
Nelco Ltd. is a leading Indian provider of satellite communication services, offering connectivity solutions to diverse sectors including maritime, enterprise, and defense. The company focuses on delivering reliable, high-quality communication services that enable customers to operate efficiently in remote and challenging environments. With a commitment to innovation and service excellence, Nelco invests in advanced technologies and skilled professionals to support evolving connectivity needs. The organization promotes a culture of safety, integrity, and continuous improvement, providing opportunities for professional growth. Nelco’s maritime connectivity services are designed to support vessels in maintaining seamless communication and data access while at sea.

**Role Description**
The Engineer – Maritime Connectivity Support role is a full-time, on-site position based in Navi Mumbai. The person in this role will provide technical support for maritime connectivity solutions, including installation, configuration, monitoring, and maintenance of satellite communication equipment and related network systems on vessels and at shore facilities. Daily responsibilities include troubleshooting connectivity issues, coordinating with internal teams and customers, documenting incidents and resolutions, and ensuring adherence to service-level agreements. The engineer will assist in system upgrades, equipment testing, and performance optimization, while following safety and compliance standards relevant to maritime operations. The role also involves preparing technical reports, supporting customer training on equipment usage, and contributing to continuous improvement of support processes.

**Qualifications**

* Strong understanding of satellite communication systems, IT network, Betworking, RF concepts, and maritime connectivity technologies.
* Knowledge of basic networking (TCP/IP, routing, switching, firewalls) and experience in configuring network devices.
* Ability to perform technical troubleshooting, diagnostics, and root cause analysis for hardware and software issues.
* Skills in preparing technical documentation, service reports, and maintaining accurate records of support activities.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills for coordinating with customers, vendors, and cross-functional teams.
* Capability to work on-site in Navi Mumbai in 24X7X365 Network operations in shifts.
* Bachelor’s degree inElectronics, Telecommunications, Electrical, or related engineering field.
* Relevant experience in satellite communications, maritime operations, or telecom support is preferred.
* Familiarity with industry standards, safety practices, and regulatory requirements related to maritime communication is an advantage.
* Ability to work in shifts or extended hours when needed to support critical operations and emergencies.

title: Manager Technical Support AV Automation
description:
**\*\*Reports to:\*\* Director

\*\*Supervises:\*\* Technical Support Engineers and Field Service Engineers

\*\*Experience:\*\* 6 to 10 years in AV, automation or IT infrastructure support, with at least 2 to 3 years in a supervisory role

\*\*Qualification:\*\* Diploma or Degree in Electronics, Electrical or related engineering stream. OEM certifications on Crestron, Extron, Biamp, Poly, Cisco or equivalent preferred.

\*\*Role Purpose\*\*

Own post-installation technical support for Play's AV and automation projects. Keep client systems running, keep the support team sharp, and keep client relationships strong after project handover.

\*\*Key Responsibilities\*\*

\*\*1. Service delivery ownership\*\*

- Own all post-installation support tickets, AMC calls and warranty cases across client sites

- Ensure response and resolution TAT per each client's SLA

- Maintain and publish a monthly ticket dashboard

\*\*2. Team supervision\*\*

- Allocate tickets and site visits based on complexity, geography and client priority

- Review field engineer reports; coach on diagnosis and documentation

- Build a technical knowledge base so recurring issues resolve faster over time

\*\*3. Troubleshooting and escalation\*\*

- First escalation point for complex issues (control systems, codec configurations, DSP tuning, AV-over-IP, UC platforms)

- Coordinate with OEM technical support for vendor-side issues

- Own RMA cycles end to end with the logistics team

\*\*4. AMC and contract management\*\*

- Review and renew AMC contracts; drive AMC to project conversion where upgrades are warranted

- Plan and execute preventive maintenance visits per contract scope

- Submit visit reports, PM checklists and sign-offs to Accounts for billing

\*\*5. Client relationship\*\*

- Primary technical point of contact for existing clients post-handover

- Attend client review meetings; share RCA for critical issues

- Flag account health risks early to the Director

\*\*6. Cross-functional coordination\*\*

- Projects team: handover protocol, as-built documentation, open-item closure

- Logistics team: spares, RMA, repair material movement

- Accounts: AMC billing, visit sign-offs, service invoicing

- Sales: upsell leads from existing accounts

\*\*7. Reporting and continuous improvement\*\*

- Monthly service MIS to Director: ticket volumes, SLA adherence, AMC revenue, recurring issue themes

- Drive at least one process improvement per quarter

\*\*Key Skills\*\*

- Hands-on troubleshooting across control systems, UC platforms, video conferencing, digital signage, room automation

- Able to read AV schematics, rack drawings and network diagrams

- Comfortable with ticketing tools and basic MIS

- Clear written and verbal communication with clients and OEMs

- Supervisory presence that is calm, structured and fair**

title: AI Application Packaging Engineer
description:

title: Subject Matter Expert
description:
Join us at Orange Business!
  
  
We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.
  
  
Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.
  
  
**About The Role**

* Customer Communication Ownership — Serve as the single point of contact (SPOC) between customers, Customer Success Managers (CSMs), and internal/external technical teams.
* Governance & Stakeholder Alignment — Organize and lead regular governance meetings, ensuring alignment across support, engineering, and service delivery entities.
* Incident & Escalation Management — Coordinate high-severity incidents, customer escalations, and cross-team troubleshooting until resolution.
* Problem & Change Coordination — Monitor adherence to problem, change, and vulnerability management processes; track open problems and ensure timely closure.
* Critical Task Tracking — Track escalated tasks, follow up with technical owners, and ensure progress and timely updates.
* HOTO Participation — Participate in handover-to-operations activities, ensuring operational readiness and tracking post-deployment actions.
* Root Cause Analysis Oversight — Ensure timely RCA submissions and communicate findings effectively to customers.
* Change Management Governance — Oversee change approvals, coordinate post-change validations, and ensure compliance with customer policies.
* Vulnerability Lifecycle Management — Track vulnerabilities, ensure remediation plans, and follow up with respective teams for closure.
* Reporting & Insights — Collate and share MIS reports, dashboards, and service insights aligned with customer expectations.
* Service Improvement Planning — Support creation of SIP/CIP reports and ensure alignment with customer initiatives and KPIs.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration — Work closely with network, security, cloud, and SOC/NOC teams to ensure seamless service delivery.
* Customer Advocacy — Represent customer interests internally and ensure proactive issue identification and resolution.

**About You**

* Managed Services Expertise — 10+ years of experience supporting managed services across network, security and cloud environments ( Including Service Management).
* Technical Background — Strong understanding of enterprise networking (WAN/LAN/WLAN), firewalls, VPNs, SD-WAN, and cloud networking.
* Security Operations Knowledge — Familiarity with SOC processes, vulnerability management, SIEM, and compliance frameworks.
* Cloud Platforms — Working knowledge of AWS, Azure, and GCP networking, identity, and security services.
* ITIL Processes — Strong understanding of ITIL processes including incident, problem, change, and service request management.
* Communication & Leadership — Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and conflict-resolution skills. Experience in operational governance and facilitating cross-functional collaboration.
* Analytical & Troubleshooting Skills — Ability to understand technical issues, interpret logs, and coordinate SME-level troubleshooting.
* Reporting & Documentation — Experience preparing dashboards, service reports, RCA summaries, and governance decks.

You bring a can-do attitude, tackle challenges head-on and challenge the status quo with new and innovative ideas.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Global Opportunities: Work in multi-national teams with opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world.
* Flexible Work Environment: Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working).
* Professional Development: Training programs and upskilling/re-skilling opportunities.
* Career Growth: Internal growth and mobility opportunities within Orange.
* Caring and Daring Culture: Health and well-being programs and benefits, diversity & inclusion initiatives, CSR and employee connect events.
* Reward Programs: Employee Referral Program, Change Maker Awards.

**Only Your Skills Matter**
Regardless of your age, gender identity, race, ethnic origin, religion/belief, sexual orientation, marital status, neurotype, disability, veteran status or appearance, we encourage diversity within our teams because it is a strength for the collective and a vector of innovation. Orange Group is a disabled-friendly company and equal opportunity employer: don't hesitate to tell us about your specific needs.

title: GMS-Senior-SSO-MFA
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**GDS – IAM MS SSO– Senior**
**Job Summary**
The SSO & Access Management Senior Consultant is responsible for providing operational support, administration, and continuous improvement of enterprise Single Sign-On (SSO) and Access Management platforms. This role supports global IAM operations through monitoring, troubleshooting, incident resolution, application onboarding, access governance, and platform optimization activities.
  
  
The consultant will work across industry-leading SSO technologies such as Okta, PingFederate, Ping One, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), and related authentication and federation solutions, while ensuring adherence to security, compliance, and service management standards.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Administer and support enterprise SSO and Access Management platforms including Okta, PingFederate, Ping One, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), and similar technologies.
* Provide L2/L3 operational support for authentication, authorization, federation, SSO, MFA, and access-related issues.
* Monitor platform health, availability, integrations, and security events to proactively identify and resolve issues.
* Manage incident, service request, problem, and change management activities in accordance with ITIL processes and SLAs.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement corrective and preventive actions for recurring issues.
* Support user lifecycle management activities, including provisioning, de-provisioning, access modifications, and entitlement management.
* Lead and support onboarding of enterprise applications to SSO platforms.
* Configure and troubleshoot SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and WS-Federation integrations.
* Coordinate with application owners, infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders during onboarding and enhancement activities.
* Manage certificates, metadata updates, federation configurations, and authentication policies.
* Support periodic access reviews, certification campaigns, and audit activities.
* Ensure compliance with organizational security standards, compliance requirements, and IAM best practices.
* Assist in implementation and maintenance of Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and access governance processes.
* Maintain operational and technical documentation, SOPs, runbooks, and knowledge articles.
* Drive continuous service improvement initiatives to enhance platform stability, user experience, and operational efficiency.
* Identify automation opportunities for repetitive operational tasks and reporting.
* Provide recommendations for improving authentication and access management processes.
* Collaborate closely with business application owners, security teams, infrastructure teams, and IAM stakeholders.
* Provide technical guidance and mentoring to junior analysts and team members.
* Participate in governance meetings, operational reviews, and client/service management discussions.
* Prepare operational reports, dashboards, KPI metrics, SLA performance reports, and management updates.

**Preferred Skills**

* 3-6 years of experience in identity and access management, with a strong focus on Okta/Ping Federate or similar IAM platforms.
* In-depth knowledge of IAM principles, SSO, MFA, directory services, and cloud identity management.
* Proven track record of managing complex user provisioning and de-provisioning scenarios.
* Familiarity with IT security standards and compliance frameworks (e.g., SOX, HIPAA, GDPR).
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills.
* Strong leadership abilities and experience mentoring junior staff.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact with various stakeholders.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., Okta Certified Administrator, Okta Certified Consultant, Okta Certified Professional) are highly desirable

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related field.

**Work Requirements**

* Willingness to work in rotational shifts supporting global operations.
* Willingness to participate in on-call support rotations.
* Ability to support critical production incidents outside standard business hours when required.
* Willingness to travel occasionally based on business requirements.
* Ability to work effectively within a Managed Services delivery model.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Customer Experience Splunk Technical Leader
description:
**Meet the Team**
As a Customer Success Technical Leader, you are passionate about customers and will fuel solutions to ensure every customer request makes the deepest impact possible for our customers and share the best-of-the-best with the team. You will be a Splunk expert and adept at understanding, adapting, and guiding our account teams and customers on how to best use our Platform.
  
  
**Your impact**
**Responsibilities**

* Skilled and aligned to Splunk Security license products, such as Enterprise Security (ES), security applications like Splunk User Behavior Analytics (UBA), and/or SOAR (Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response)
* Highly skilled and aligned to Splunk’s Core licensed product, such as Enterprise and Cloud.
* Strategically support the Customer Success Executive, Technical Success Engineer, Solution Engineer, Solution Architect motions.
* Develop strong partnership with Sales/Customer Success roles to assist Area aligned customers with Value Realization. Activities include, but not limited to:

+ Onboarding & Enablement – deliver workshops, prescriptive guidance/assistance, achieve onboarding milestones
+ Health Review & Remediation
+ Security Use Case Activation
+ Proactively engaging Technical Success Engineers to review and assess their account’s health situation, with an emphasis on accounts that have telemetry risk signals and/or 6 months from renewal date.
+ Proactively engaging Customer Success Executives on adoption/use case-related work opportunity.
+ Proactively engage CS/SE Management to ensure priority focus alignment and address risk accounts themes.
+ Strategic case-based delivery, up to 90 days of assistance, which is requested by internal Area aligned account teams or management. This typically involves providing customers with high-quality technical advice on Enterprise level architecture, implementation, configuration and optimization work in complex environments for Splunk Enterprise Security, UBA/UEBA, and/or SOAR.

**As a Customer Success Technical Leader, you will**

* Be passionate about customers and deliver impactful solutions.
* Address organizations’ complex technical challenges, proactively identifying and resolving issues before they impact the customer.
* Be a self-motivated Splunk expert eager to learn and adapt in a multifaceted environment.
* Guide account team members and customers on optimal use of Splunk Platform and Splunk Enterprise Security. Provide recommendations for a customer’s overall technical health.
* Deliver strategic, case-based technical consulting (up to 90 days).
* Collaborate with internal resources and customer-facing teams to manage customer needs.
* Conduct research from various resources with the ability to consistently find answers to questions and solve complex technical problems.
* Execute consultative conversations with decision makers to diagnose and establish the potential value of solving business issues, change or expand existing solution requirements based on your discovery/assessment, and provide broader based recommendations to help customers accelerate their product initiatives, optimize cost, and maximize performance.
* Gain agreement with account team members and customer decision-makers on the tangible value of proposed solutions.
* Deliver customer onboarding enablement-based workshops and achieve success milestones.
* Contribute to practice KPIs through process and collateral improvements, tool development, and implementation.

**Minimum Qualifications-**

* Deep technical knowledge of Splunk Enterprise Security (ES) configuration, administration, and development, including expertise in Assets and Identities, Threat Intelligence, Notable Events, Adaptive Response, and Risk-based Analytics.
* Data Management: Experience with integrating and normalising data from diverse sources. Understanding of the Common Information Model (CIM) and experience with data onboarding, including forwarding architecture and technical add-ons.
* Strong command of Search Processing Language (SPL); experience developing and optimizing correlation and risk-based alerting rules.
* Strong Splunk architecture, data onboarding, and Splunk Core product feature experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Cybersecurity Domain: Solid foundation in security operations, forensics, threat hunting, insider threats, and compliance.
* Cybersecurity Frameworks: Solid foundation in NIST CSF, CIS, HIPAA, PCI DSS
* Industry Standard Security Certifications: GIAC, CISSP, OSCP or equivalent
* Infrastructure: Understanding of enterprise architecture across on-premise and Cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Splunk Certifications/Accreditations: ES Implementation Accreditation and/or SOAR consultant I & II
* Understanding of enterprise architecture across on-premise and Cloud environments
* Statistical and analytical modeling skills are a plus.
* Proficiency with scripting languages (bash), application development (Java, Python, .NET), databases, and analytical tools.
* Hands-on experience with Splunk product implementation of focus and Splunk Cloud.
* Experience with cloud migration projects.
* Solid experience in technical consulting or big-data analytics.

**Soft Skills-**

* Trusted technical advisor with the ability to lead assigned tickets and priorities. Engages in “out of the box” thinking to resolve problems
* Relationship Management - Establish technical credibility with a wide range of internal and customer contacts with the ability to “read” the internal/customer contact and adapt behavior / approach
* Conflict Resolution - Ability to engage in escalation management
* Influencing/Negotiating - Ability to influence peers, Splunk leadership and customers. Ability to handle highly complex/distributed IT environments and/or accounts that demand a high level of negotiation and conflict resolution abilities
* Problem/Need Identification - Demonstrates a deep comprehension of the customers, account team and/or customer’s business strategy, business objectives & challenges, success criteria/how customer measures success, and training needs. Analyzes trends to predict changes that may impact customer’s long-term business goals
* Mentor/Team Player - Possesses ability to take on mentorship roles as identified by management team. Identifies, defines, and leads Priorities to Improve to help team reach its goals
* Communication: Excellent written and oral communication skills. Active listening and objective consideration of others’ opinions.
* Strong customer-facing skills to instill confidence and guide towards resolution.
* Ability to balance multiple account teams, customers and challenging priorities effectively.

* Strong understanding of identity lifecycle management, access governance, and application provisioning.
* Experience handling critical production incidents and meeting SLA commitments.
* Experience with enterprise application onboarding, integration troubleshooting, and production deployments.
* Ability to independently investigate complex technical issues and drive permanent resolutions.
* Saviynt certification is preferred but not mandatory.

 

 

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. L3 Production Support**

* Handle complex L3 incidents, service requests, and problem tickets related to Saviynt Enterprise Identity Cloud (EIC).
* Troubleshoot critical issues related to user provisioning, deprovisioning, access requests, certifications, and account reconciliation.
* Perform root cause analysis for recurring incidents and implement permanent fixes.
* Analyze application logs, job execution details, provisioning failures, connector errors, and workflow issues.
* Support P1/P2 incidents, participate in bridge calls, and provide timely technical updates.
* Ensure compliance with SLA, incident management, change management, and problem management processes.

**B. Saviynt Configuration and Administration**

* Troubleshoot and maintain Saviynt workflows, access request processes, approval chains, and business rules.
* Support identity lifecycle processes, including Joiner, Mover, and Leaver (JML).
* Configure and troubleshoot analytics, campaigns, access reviews, and certification processes.
* Investigate issues involving roles, entitlements, access policies, user accounts, and identity attributes.
* Support configuration changes, platform enhancements, and production releases.

**C. Application Integrations and Provisioning**

* Troubleshoot Saviynt integrations with Active Directory, LDAP, SAP, databases, REST APIs, and other enterprise applications.
* Diagnose account aggregation, entitlement import, reconciliation, and provisioning failures.
* Analyze connector configurations, connection settings, API responses, and transformation logic.
* Support application onboarding, connectivity validation, and integration testing.
* Resolve issues related to account correlation, orphan accounts, duplicate identities, and entitlement mismatches.

**D. Advanced Technical Troubleshooting**

* Troubleshoot complex SQL queries, Saviynt analytics, data transformations, and identity attribute mapping.
* Investigate failed scheduled jobs, long-running tasks, stuck requests, and reconciliation discrepancies.
* Analyze REST API calls, JSON payloads, HTTP response codes, and integration errors.
* Identify performance bottlenecks and recommend configuration or process improvements.
* Support custom connector troubleshooting and integration enhancements using Saviynt Connector Framework where applicable.

**E. Governance, Compliance and Security**

* Troubleshoot access certification campaigns, SoD violations, policy evaluation, and access review issues.
* Support audit requests, compliance reporting, and access governance controls.
* Ensure least-privilege access and appropriate segregation of duties.
* Review production changes and ensure adherence to security and change management standards.

**F. L3 Escalation and Team Collaboration**

* Act as the final technical escalation point for L1/L2 support teams.
* Provide technical guidance, knowledge transfer, and mentoring to support engineers.
* Prepare RCA documents, known-error records, SOPs, and technical runbooks.
* Coordinate with application owners, infrastructure teams, vendors, and business stakeholders.
* Identify automation opportunities to reduce recurring incidents and manual operational effort.

Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**
The Networking Service Delivery Field Support Engineer (L1) is responsible for providing a professional first-line onsite technical support and field engineering service to clients by proactively identifying and resolving technical incidents and problems. Through pre-emptive service incident and resolution activities, this role restores service to clients by managing incidents and seeing them through to an effective resolution. The primary objective of this role is to ensure all requests, process events and resolution incidents result in zero missed Service Level Agreement (SLA) conditions. The role is responsible for managing standard and low complexity incidents, conducting routine, repetitive tasks whilst using readily available information and following standard practices and procedures.
  
  
**Key responsibilities:**

* Ensures that the assigned infrastructure at the client site is configured, installed, tested and operational.
* Ensures that any software that is part of the solution is installed and configured according to client requirements.
* Proactively identifies problems and errors as they occur and logs such incidents in a timely manner with the required level of detail.
* Liaises with all stakeholders including client IT environments, carriers and colleagues to expediate diagnosis of errors and problems and to identify a resolution.
* Investigates first line support calls assigned and identify the root cause of incidents and problems following knowledge articles.
* Responds to and diagnoses all alerts, escalate to L2 Field Engineer when unable to resolve within the stipulated time.
* Ensures incidents are updated with progress and resolution details in a timely manner using the required platform.
* Ensures the efficient and comprehensive resolution of incidents and requests.
* Applies tools, techniques and processes to track, log, report on and correct configuration items, components and changes.
* Investigates problems in systems, processes and services and assists with the implementation of agreed remedies and preventative measures.
* Provides first line remote and onsite technical support to clients.
* Provides first line field engineering services to clients.
* Reports and escalates issues to 3rd party vendors if necessary.
* Follows the required handover procedures for shift changes to ensure service continuity.

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**

* Good communicate skills, both verbal and written.
* Ability to plan activities and projects well in advance, and take into account possible changing circumstances.
* Ability to maintain a positive outlook at work.
* Ability to work well in a pressurized environment.
* Ability to work hard and put in longer hours when it is necessary.
* Ability to apply active listening techniques such as paraphrasing the message to confirm understanding, probing for further relevant information and refraining from interrupting.
* Ability to adapt to changing circumstances.
* Ability to place client at the forefront of all interactions, understanding their requirements and creating a positive client experience throughout the total client journey.

**Academic qualifications and certifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Information Technology or Computing or related field.
* Associate level certification in different Networking technologies such as Cisco, Juniper, Aruba, F5, CCNA, JNCIA, ACMA etc.

**Required experience:**

* Entry level experience in Networking technologies such as routing, switching, Wireless, SDI distribution, core and access layers.
* Entry level experience in technical support to clients.
* Entry level experience in diagnosis and troubleshooting.
* Entry level experience providing remote support in Networking technologies.
* Entry level experience in relevant technology.

**Workplace type:**
On-site Working
  
  
**About NTT DATA**
NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune
  
  
Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through
  
  
responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with
  
  
unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and
  
  
application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move
  
  
confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more
  
  
than 70 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as
  
  
established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each
  
  
year in R&D.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.
  
  
**Third parties fraudulently posing as NTT DATA recruiters**
NTT DATA recruiters will never ask job seekers or candidates for payment or banking information during the recruitment process, for any reason. title: Service Desk Lead
description:
**About Us**
WHY LINEDATA ?
  
  
Join us in shaping the fintech of tomorrow.
  
  
With more than 1,350 colleagues across 20 locations worldwide, you'll help build cutting-edge platforms and tailored services that power the daily operations of 700 leading financial institutions. As a global, multicultural company with over 45 nationalities represented and just as many languages spoken, we thrive on diverse perspectives and collaboration. **Service Desk Lead : L3 Escalations**

Mumbai / Pune
  
  
**Experience:**
8-10 years
  
  
**Shift:**
Mandatory US business-hours coverage
  
  
**Role**
Lead L2/L3 Service Desk operations, manage escalations and Major Incidents, and ensure SLA, queue, quality and customer-experience targets are met.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead queue management, workload allocation, shift handovers, SLA/aging control and escalations.

ITIL certification; Okta, Zscaler/ZIA, Mimecast

title: Data Center Technician, Server Operation
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Experience with performing component-level repairs and troubleshooting on technical equipment.
* Experience with diagnosing and troubleshooting operating systems, computer hardware and server hardware.
* Experience with networking protocols.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 4 years of experience in maintenance and monitoring of server systems.
* Experience with performing component-level repairs and troubleshooting on IT equipment or in a similar role (e.g., Systems Administration, Network Deployment Engineer, Help Desk Technician, etc.).
* Experience working within a data center or network operation center environment.
* Experience with Linux operating systems.

**About The Job**
Google isn't just a software company. The Hardware Operations team is responsible for monitoring the state-of-the-art physical infrastructure behind Google's powerful search technology. As an Operations Technician, you'll install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software (like Google's Linux cluster). You'll also take on the configuration of more complex components such as networks, routers, hubs, bridges, switches and networking protocols. You'll participate in or lead small project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans. A typical day involves manual movement and installation of racks, and while it can sometimes be physically demanding, you are excited to work with infrastructure that is at the cutting-edge of computer technology.
  
  
In this role, your duties range from the physical deployment of DC related technology to working closely with various stakeholders. It will fall on you to ensure that our goals, missions and projects are successfully delivered, and, more importantly, that they are repeatable across our global array of DCs. A typical day involves movement and installation of equipment, and while it can sometimes be physically demanding, you’re excited to work with infrastructure that is at the cutting-edge of computer technology to ensure Google DC quality and reliability.
  
  
The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical and HVAC systems in the world. We are an upbeat, creative, team-oriented group of engineers committed to building and operating powerful data centers.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Deploy and operate new data center infrastructure across projects or teams (e.g., machine learning platforms, network architecture).
* Report issues and follow data center procedures to troubleshoot and diagnose moderately complex issues with equipment or infrastructure as they arise, and identify the resources needed to resolve identified issues.
* Diagnose, repair, and perform preventative maintenance on equipment, servers, machines, and infrastructure based on identified issues with multiple solutions, independently.
* Execute advanced operational procedures as part of daily work activities and follow security policies and processes.
* Work in shift pattern to meet evolving business needs and operational schedules.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: Implementation Specialist (Senior IT Analyst)
description:
At Dow, we believe in putting people first and we’re passionate about delivering integrity, respect and safety to our customers, our employees and the planet.
  
  
Our people are at the heart of our solutions. They reflect the communities we live in and the world where we do business. Their diversity is our strength. Our purpose is simple - to deliver a sustainable future for the world through science and collaboration. If you’re looking for a challenge and meaningful role, you’re in the right place.

As an Implementation (Senior IT Analyst), you will support end-to-end implementations and deployments across software, infrastructure, digital transformation, and mergers, acquisitions, and divestiture projects. Working as part of an implementation team, you will manage the deployment of complex software or technical solutions for enterprise clients. Key responsibilities include leading implementation projects, configuring systems, managing data migration, directing testing activities, coordinating cross-functional teams, and training users to enable a seamless transition and faster time-to-value.
  
  
You are responsible for applying technical expertise, established best practices, and sound judgment to analyze and resolve problems. Your performance directly influences the quality of your work and your team’s outcomes and requires adherence to established guidelines and policies.
  
  
This role requires an understanding of the key business drivers within your discipline and function, along with the ability to expand both conceptual and practical knowledge in your area of expertise. You are expected to provide informal guidance to new team members and clearly explain complex information to..
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Project Delivery: Drive or support end-to-end enterprise infrastructure or software deployments from kickoff to launch.
* Configure Technical Solutions: Sets up advanced platform capabilities, including integrations, security requirements, data mapping, and configurations tailored to client needs.
* Data Migration: Oversee the secure extraction, transformation, and loading of client data.
* Manage Enterprise Clients: Act as the primary technical advisor for high-value corporate stakeholders.
* Quality Assurance & Troubleshooting: Leads product test and user acceptance testing (UAT), identifies root causes for integration defects, and resolves production blockers.
* Stakeholder Management: Communicates project status, timelines, and potential roadblocks to both internal executives and client stakeholders.
* Standardize Operational Playbooks: Build reusable implementation templates to accelerate customer time-to-value.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in IT discipline preferred or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience.
* Excellent communication skills to explain complex concepts and build consensus.
* Good to have experience into HP ALM.

**Your**
**Skill**
**s**

* Analytical & Problem-Solving: Ability to analyze error trends, perform root-cause analysis, and recommend effective long-term fixes.
* Communication: Exceptional capability to translate highly technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and business users.
* Technical Proficiency: Excellent understanding & practical knowledge of IT Infrastructure, operating systems, networking, integrations, application development etc..
* Project Management: Ability to coordinate software implementations, upgrades, and testing phases with minimal supervision.

**Additional Notes**

* No relocation support is provided on the role.

**Benefits – What Dow Offers You**
We invest in you.
  
  
Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing.
  
  
Here are just a few highlights of what you would be offered as a Dow employee:

title: Facility Operations Center Engineer, DCC Communities
description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth! Amazon is a place where builders can build. We hire the world's brightest minds and offer them an environment in which they can invent and innovate to improve the experience for our customers. If you'd like to help us build a place where you can find and buy anything online, this is the job for you.
  
  
The ideal candidate will need to have an understanding of data center IT Infrastructure and data center Facilities infrastructure and how the two entities co-exist. The successful candidate will be responsible for providing assistance and support to the onsite team in India.
  
  
The position will help ensure overall availability and reliability to meet or exceed defined service levels.
  
  
Qualified candidates must also have experience functioning in a large-scale data center and have demonstrated and displayed the ability to think outside of the box. This skill is essential, as the candidate will assist with aligning the Facility Operations Center with the larger objectives of other business and peer organizations.
  
  
You will need to play a role with growing the team to a standard of operational excellence in India.
  
  
If you are passionate about the Customer Experience; you think and act globally; and you want to contribute to the operational excellence of Amazon Data Centers, then this may be the challenge you’ve been looking for!
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
Roles, Responsibilities and Requirements (job description is not meant to be an all-inclusive statement of every duty and responsibility required):
  
  

* Monitors the global data center Amazon facilities infrastructure platform in india
* Serves as a Point of Contact for internal and external teams
* Assists with the development of communication and escalation protocols designed to improve the team’s performance
* Contributes to outage post mortem analysis
* Ensures records are updated in a timely manner
* Assists with coordination and communication during emergency recovery efforts
* Assists with the development of tools that will enhance the team’s performance
* The ability to support a 24X7 environment in India (This is shift work which may require that you work weekends and holidays)

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of relevant work in a data center or other critical environment experience
* Experience in data center engineering or operations
* Experience in operations and on-call support for data center facilities, mission critical plants, or production facilities

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of data center or mission critical facilities (example: hospital, military facility, public safety facility, etc.) experience
* Bachelor's degree in enginnering or equivalent
* 3+ years of facilities management experience
* Knowledge of mission critical systems (data centers, hospitals, power plants, military facilities, etc.)

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

description:

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is growing rapidly, and we are looking for Data Center Technician to join our expanding Infrastructure Operations team.
  
  
Data Center Operations designs, installs and maintains the world’s largest Computing Infrastructure. Our scope of work includes systems, repairing, dealing with issues, handling and tracking parts and assisting in Data Center maintenance. Amazon Data Centers are large-scale high-density centers where you will help change the face of Technology in the region.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
**Responsibilities**
As Data Centre Operations Engineer, you will be the primary point of contact for internal customers. There is never a dull moment as each day presents itself with different challenges. Some of the key responsibilities you will undertake are:
  
  

* You will troubleshoot technical issues on advanced hardware, ranging from servers, storage and networking devices on a 24/7 basis.
* You will maintain a high level of system reliability and availability.
* You will participate in projects to enhance operational efficiencies with opportunities to share experiences and knowledge with our global network of technical experts.
* You will share knowledge and help train less technical staff on the best practices related to all service owner issues
* You will contribute towards building a great team by getting involved in the Amazon hiring process/candidate interviews

A day in the life
  
  
As a successful Data Center Operations engineer, your day-to-day work will include:

Reporting to the Digital Group Portfolio Manager, the role improves portfolio visibility, PPM adoption, data quality and operational discipline across Brennan’s project and portfolio management processes.
  
  
The role is expected to consistently use available AI tools to improve speed, accuracy and efficiency across PPM support, reporting, analysis, training material maintenance and continual improvement activities. This is not a traditional manual administration role; the successful candidate will proactively reduce repetitive effort, identify patterns, streamline tasks and use AI to deliver faster, more reliable portfolio support outcomes.
  
  
**Role Responsibilities**
**Project & Portfolio Management (PPM) Tool End-user Support**

* Provide first level support to end users of Brennan’s Project & Portfolio Management (PPM) tool, including how-to guidance, navigation support and assistance with day-to-day usage queries.
* Support onboarding of new starters by delivering basic PPM tool training and helping users understand required processes, data entry standards and project information hygiene expectations.
* Own, maintain and continually improve PPM training materials, including user guides, FAQs, work instructions and training handbooks.
* Troubleshoot level 1 PPM tool issues, triage user queries, capture recurring problems and escalate system or process issues where additional support is required.
* Use available AI tools to identify recurring PPM support issues, improve guidance materials and reduce repetitive user support effort.

**Service Pack Coordination**

* Coordinate a portfolio of small, simple service packs that do not require client-facing project management, ensuring delivery information remains accurate and current.
* Maintain service pack updates in Brennan’s PPM tool, including status, key dates, assigned resources, progress notes and closure information.
* Ensure resource planning tools are updated to reflect resource allocation, planned effort and delivery timing against each service pack.
* Monitor service pack progress and follow up with delivery resources or internal stakeholders to confirm updates, identify blockers and support timely completion.
* Maintain consistent information hygiene across service pack records so portfolio reporting, resource planning and operational visibility remain reliable.

**Digital Group Portfolio Manager Support**

* Provide ad-hoc support to the Digital Group Portfolio Manager across portfolio reporting, data analysis, administration and operational follow-up activities.
* Assist with preparing portfolio reports, dashboards, summaries and analysis using information from PPM, resource planning and other delivery management tools.
* Use available AI tools to identify recurring support themes, data quality gaps, reporting inconsistencies and process inefficiencies, then translate insights into practical improvement actions.
* Proactively identify continual improvement opportunities and maintain a backlog of initiatives to improve ways of working, system usage, data quality and portfolio support processes.
* Maintain all project management guidelines, playbooks and templates, ensuring the latest versions are available and accessible to all PMs.

**Stakeholder Engagement & Communication**

* Communicate clearly with PPM users, delivery teams, project managers and practice stakeholders to support accurate tool usage and timely updates.
* Respond to PPM user queries, provide simple guidance and escalate issues where further support is required.
* Follow up with internal stakeholders to keep service pack status, resource allocation and delivery information current.
* Use available AI tools to summarise support activity, service pack progress, blockers, data quality issues and recurring stakeholder themes into clear updates for the Digital Group Portfolio Manager.
* Maintain clear records of requests, actions, decisions and outcomes to support reporting and follow-up.

**Key Competencies And Qualifications Required**

* 5+ years’ experience working in portfolio, PMO, project coordination, project administration or professional services support environments, preferably within a technology services business.
* Demonstrated exposure to portfolio-level ways of working, including project governance, status reporting, data quality, resource planning, templates, playbooks and operational follow-up.
* Experience supporting users of project, portfolio or resource planning tools, including responding to how-to queries, assisting new users, maintaining training materials and troubleshooting basic issues.
* Experience maintaining accurate project, portfolio or operational data in tools and trackers, with strong attention to data quality, status updates, information hygiene and reporting accuracy.
* Exposure to resource planning, scheduling, capacity tracking or allocation management across multiple small work packages, projects or service activities.
* Experience working with geographically distributed stakeholders, with the ability to follow up actions, communicate clearly, manage competing priorities and escalate issues when required.
* Mandatory Skills and Technology
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Project Operations is mandatory, including project setup, project records, tasks, resource assignments, time or effort visibility, status information, reporting inputs and data quality management.
* Strong administration, coordination and follow-up skills, with the ability to maintain accurate records, track actions and keep portfolio information current.
* Confident supporting business users with project, portfolio and resource planning tools, including providing simple guidance, basic training and level 1 troubleshooting.
* Strong attention to detail and data quality, with the ability to identify gaps, inconsistencies or missing updates in PPM and resource planning tools.
* Proven ability to consistently use available AI tools to improve speed, accuracy and efficiency across reporting, analysis, support triage, documentation maintenance and continual improvement activities.
* Ability to own, maintain and continually improve user guides, FAQs, work instructions, training handbooks, PM guidelines, artefacts, playbooks and templates.

**Highly Desired Skills and Technology**

* Confident using Microsoft 365 tools, including Teams, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint and Planner, to support communication, reporting, tracking and administration.
* Intermediate Excel skills, with the ability to work with lists, filters, tables and basic reporting outputs to support portfolio analysis and data quality checks.
* Basic exposure to reporting or dashboard tools, such as Power BI, to support portfolio reporting, analysis and data quality checks.
* Ability to log, prioritise, track and follow up support requests through to resolution or escalation.
* Basic understanding of project lifecycle, resource planning, scheduling and reporting concepts required to support service pack coordination and portfolio visibility.

title: API Support Engineer
description:
Experience: 0–2 years in API support, application support, integration support, or a similar technical role.

Job Location: Mumbai or Pune

Job Type: Full-time

Job Summary: We are looking for an API Support Engineer responsible for monitoring, troubleshooting, and supporting APIs and system integrations with clients, suppliers, and third-party service providers.

The candidate will work closely with the Development, QA, Product, Database, and Infrastructure teams to identify API issues, analyze technical problems, coordinate resolutions, and ensure stable operation of production systems.

Experience in Travel / OTA / Hotel Booking / APIs will be an added advantage.

Key Responsibilities

1. API Monitoring & Support

Monitor API performance, availability, response time, error rates, and transaction failures. Monitor production APIs and identify abnormal behavior or service interruptions. Investigate API failures, timeouts, slow responses, incorrect responses, and connectivity issues. Ensure critical API issues are identified and escalated promptly. Perform regular health checks of APIs and integrations.

2. API Troubleshooting

Analyze API requests and responses to identify the root cause of issues.

Troubleshoot REST APIs, JSON, XML, HTTP/HTTPS, authentication, headers, parameters, and response codes. Check request/response logs and application logs. Identify whether an issue is related to the client, supplier, application, database, network, or infrastructure. Coordinate with development teams for code-level issues. Coordinate with suppliers/third parties for external API issues.

5. Logs & Database Analysis

Analyze application and API logs to identify errors and transaction failures. Perform basic SQL queries to investigate transaction and booking-related issues. Verify data consistency between API responses, application databases, and supplier systems.

Work with senior developers/DBAs for complex database-related issues.

6. Client & Supplier Coordination

Communicate with clients and suppliers regarding API connectivity and transaction issues. Collect complete technical information before escalating an issue. Share request/response details, timestamps, booking references, error messages, and relevant logs with the concerned team. Follow up with external suppliers until the issue is resolved. Provide clear technical updates to internal teams and clients.

7. Incident Management

Prioritize incidents based on business impact and severity. Immediately escalate major issues affecting bookings, revenue, API availability, or multiple clients. Maintain incident timelines and resolution details. Perform basic root-cause analysis and prepare incident reports for major issues. Identify recurring problems and recommend permanent solutions.

Required Technical Skills.

Good understanding of REST APIs and API integration. Strong knowledge of JSON and XML. Understanding of HTTP/HTTPS and HTTP status codes. Experience with Postman / Swagger. Basic to good knowledge of SQL and relational databases. Ability to analyze application and API logs.

Soft Skills

Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills. Good communication skills. Ability to work under pressure during production incidents. Good coordination with Development, QA, Product, Infrastructure, clients, and suppliers. Travel Domain Knowledge – Preferred

Qualification

Bachelor's degree / Diploma in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field.

Preferred Experience.

0–2 years of experience in API Support, Application Support, Production Support, Integration Support, or a similar technical role.

Candidates with experience in Travel Technology / OTA / Hotel Booking Systems / API Integration will be given preference.

description:

technology is delivered is every bit as important as

The role will be responsible for overall coordination and facilitation of technical and other resources through service restoration and recovery efforts for escalated incidents.
  
  
**Role Responsibility**
**Incident Management [40%]**
Own and manage the end-to-end lifecycle of P1/P2 incidents with minimal business impact.

Escalate risks and service-impacting issues as required.
  
  
Support a 24x7 operational environment and major incident response activities.
  
  
**Problem Management [30%]**

Facilitate post-incident review meetings and lessons-learned discussions.
  
  
Track corrective and preventive actions to completion.
  
  
**Key Competencies**
**Stakeholder involvement**
Consistent identification and involvement of stakeholders who need to be consulted in the decision-making process
  
  
Establish and maintain effective working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
  
  
Proactively engage relevant stakeholders to gather requirements, feedback, and business insights.
  
  
Ensure stakeholder expectations are managed through clear and timely communication.
  
  
**Adaptability and Multitasking**
Adapt to changing work environments, priorities, and organizational needs with a positive attitude. Swiftly process information and manage multiple tasks accurately.

title: Infrastructure Engineer II – Reporting & Analytic Capabilities
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**

* Support the global Enterprise Reporting and Analytics team in managing and enhancing enterprise-supported reporting platforms, including Tableau, Looker, SAP BusinessObjects, Metric Insights, and Power BI.
* This role carries primary ownership of one or two reporting platforms, covering application maintenance, configuration, support, and roadmap planning.

* Required to support and maintain enterprise reporting platforms, including Tableau, Looker, SAP BusinessObjects, Metric Insights, and Power BI and own the operational health and stability of assigned platforms.

* Coordinate and execute periodic OS-level security patching, middleware upgrades, and application-server updates for reporting-platform hosts.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Hold a full-time graduation from an accredited university.
* Bring a total minimum of 6 years of IT experience with a relevant minimum of 4 years of experience in supporting reporting, analytics, or other enterprise application platforms.
* Support and maintain enterprise reporting platforms, including Tableau, Looker, SAP BusinessObjects, Metric Insights, and Power BI.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Having experience with multiple reporting and analytics tools for maintenance and support including Tableau, Metric Insights, SAP BusinessObjects, Power BI, or Looker will be a preferred advantage
* Have exposure to tools such as CDSW and R-Studio Connect.
* Familiarity with GitOps practices, ArgoCD, Helm, or Kubernetes-based deployment patterns.

* Knowledge of certificate lifecycle management, secrets management, and identity and access management.
* Experience in scripting and automation using Python, Bash, or PowerShell for operational task automation, data processing, and platform management.

Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Senior IT Service Desk Analyst
description:
We are a global consultancy group, combining multi-disciplined expertise to deliver marine, engineering and technical services that drive safety and sustainability in maritime, oil & gas and renewable energy sectors.
  
  
With a legacy dating back to 1856 – to the world’s first marine surveying organisation, The Salvage Association – Aqualis continues to evolve to provide the deepest pool of technical expertise across marine and engineering disciplines in more locations worldwide, to best support our clients and markets in keeping the world moving today, whilst managing the challenges of tomorrow.
  
  
The Senior IT Service Desk Analyst will provide technical support and assistance to staff across various regions and time zones. With strong technical skills and a customer-oriented mindset, you will act as an escalation point for the most complex incidents and service requests. Your role is crucial in ensuring the smooth operation of IT services and delivering a high-quality customer experience.
  
  
**What will you be doing?**

* Deliver an exceptional customer experience by managing service desk interactions professionally and efficiently.
* Provide technical support in accordance with service desk policies, procedures, and service level agreements (SLAs).
* Triage, diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve hardware, software, system, network, and user account issues for both local and remote users.
* Gather information through effective questioning to identify root causes and implement appropriate solutions.
* Guide users through issue resolution via phone, email, chat, and remote support tools.
* Keep users informed with timely updates and escalate unresolved or complex issues to the appropriate teams when required.
* Manage and prioritise multiple incidents and service requests to ensure agreed response and resolution targets are achieved.
* Accurately document incidents, requests, resolutions, and customer interactions within service management systems.
* Install, configure, maintain, and support Windows operating systems, end-user devices, and business applications.
* Research, identify, and implement workarounds and permanent solutions to technical issues.
* Collaborate with internal teams and third-party vendors to resolve hardware, software, and infrastructure-related issues.
* Maintain and contribute to the service desk knowledge base, ensuring information remains accurate and up to date.
* Promote adherence to service desk processes, policies, and best practices to ensure consistent service delivery.
* Act as an escalation point for complex incidents, providing technical guidance and support to colleagues.
* Monitor service trends, identify recurring problems, and recommend proactive improvements to reduce future incidents.
* Work closely with IT Service Desk leadership to support continuous improvement initiatives and the effective operation of the service desk.
* Identify training needs and support the delivery of technical and customer service development programmes.
* Coach and mentor team members to enhance their technical expertise, service quality, and customer support skills.
* Foster a collaborative team environment and maintain strong working relationships with stakeholders across the business.
* Promote awareness and adoption of IT products and services available to the organisation.

**What are we looking for?**

* Minimum 3 years' experience in an IT Service Desk environment.
* Familiarity with ITIL best practices or IT Service Management (ITSM) frameworks.
* Advanced knowledge of Windows operating systems and Windows Server administration.
* Administration and support of Microsoft 365, including Teams, OneDrive and SharePoint Online.
* Experience with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure Active Directory), Intune, and Microsoft Azure.
* Strong understanding of network infrastructure and technologies, including routers, switches, firewalls, DHCP, DNS and VPNs.
* Experience with backup, recovery and restoration processes.
* Knowledge of audio-visual and conferencing technologies.
* Fluent in English.

**Further Information**
*This position will be based at our office in Govandi East, Mumbai.*
*You must have the right to live and work in India.*
*You must be able to work on a shift rotation, including 06:00-14:00,14:00-22:00 and 22:00-06:00. You must also be able to work public holidays on occasion.*
*You can learn more about our team and what we do here:*
*https://aqualis-group.com/*
*To ensure your application is considered, please submit it using the link provided on this page.*
*NO RECRUITMENT AGENCIES.*
**Our Commitment To D&I**
At Aqualis Group, we are committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to thrive, regardless of background, identity, or role. As a global company, we believe that diversity drives innovation and inclusion strengthens our teams. We support flexible working, accessible environments, and employee wellbeing. Even if your experience doesn’t match every requirement, we encourage you to apply—your unique perspective could be just what we need.
