title: Customer Support Associate - Technical 2nd Line
description:
**About ZDHC**
The ZDHC Foundation develops and implements the Roadmap to Zero Programme with a focus on reducing the chemical footprint of the Fashion Industry. We are the leading sustainability organisation driving sustainable chemistry, innovations and best practices in textile, apparel, leather and footwear manufacturing to protect consumers, workers and the environment. Through collaborative engagement, alignment and large-scale implementation, we take a holistic approach to sustainable chemical management and enable tangible progress in the wider industry through the delivery of guidelines, platforms and solutions, including capacity-building and innovation projects. For more information about ZDHC, see www.roadmaptozero.com and follow us on LinkedIn.
  
  
**ZDHC Vision and Mission**
The ZDHC Vision is a World in which better chemistry leads to the protection of life, land, air and water. The ZDHC Mission is to lead our global value chain to achieve the highest standard for sustainable chemical management, driving resource efficiency and circularity.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The
**Customer Support Associate – Technical 2nd Line**
provides specialised technical support within the Customer Support Team, acting as the link between first-line Customer Support and the Platform Development Team.
  
  
The role investigates and resolves technical issues escalated by first-line support or other internal teams, ensuring that issues are accurately analysed, documented, prioritised and followed through to resolution. Working closely with the Platform Product Owner and Development Team, the role supports effective bug management, platform testing and the successful release of new functionalities and enhancements.
  
  
Through hands-on investigation, structured testing and close collaboration across teams, the role contributes to a reliable, user-friendly platform and a high-quality customer experience. The role is intended for candidates who combine strong customer-support capabilities with a genuine software development mindset.
  
  
**Key Roles And Responsibilities**
**Second-Line Technical Support & Troubleshooting**

* Provide second-line technical support for platform-related questions and issues escalated by first-line Customer Support and other internal teams.
* Investigate reported technical issues to understand and reproduce problems, distinguish between user-related issues and potential platform bugs, and identify possible root causes.
* Resolve technical support cases independently where possible and escalate issues requiring development support to the appropriate team.
* Identify recurring technical issues and patterns and proactively flag opportunities to improve platform functionality, user experience or support processes.

**Technical Skills & Platform Development Capabilities**

* Apply a strong technical understanding of modern web-based applications, including APIs, databases, authentication flows, application architecture and common integration patterns.
* Use practical development skills and experience with at least one modern programming language or web development framework to support technical troubleshooting and root-cause analysis, including reading and understanding source code.
* Investigate complex technical issues using browser developer tools, application logs, API requests and responses, database queries and other relevant debugging tools.
* Work closely with the Platform Product Owner and Development Team to clarify technical issues and support effective prioritisation and resolution.

**Bug Management, Testing & Quality Assurance**

* Create clear and complete technical tickets, including issue descriptions, reproduction steps, expected versus actual behaviour, supporting evidence and relevant user information.
* Track technical issues and bugs through to resolution and ensure relevant stakeholders are kept informed of progress and outcomes.
* Support the testing of new platform functionalities, features, enhancements and bug fixes before and after release.
* Conduct structured functional and regression testing and clearly document testing results, issues and observations.
* Verify resolved bugs and fixes before tickets are closed and confirm that the expected functionality is working correctly.

**Knowledge Sharing & Cross-Team Collaboration**

* Translate technical findings into clear and understandable information for first-line Customer Support and other non-technical colleagues.
* Support the development and maintenance of internal troubleshooting guidance, technical support documentation and relevant Knowledge Base content.
* Collaborate closely with Customer Support, Platform Development and other relevant teams to ensure an effective flow of information between users and technical teams.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Relevant education or equivalent professional experience in customer support, technical support, IT, digital platforms or a related field.
* Previous experience in customer support, technical support, application support, software testing or a comparable role.
* Experience working with web-based platforms, software applications or digital products.
* Experience investigating and troubleshooting technical issues and translating findings into clear, actionable tickets.
* Experience with ticketing, issue-tracking or development tools; experience with tools such as Jira, Linear, Confluence, Notion, Asana or similar is an advantage.
* Experience with functional software testing, bug reproduction and/or regression testing is an advantage.
* Strong digital literacy and the ability to quickly understand new systems, functionalities and technical processes.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical colleagues and translate between customer/user issues and technical requirements.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
* Experience working in an international and cross-functional environment is an advantage.

**Competencies**

* Accountability — Take responsibility for actions and results, stay accountable for successes and failures, and ensure commitments and standards are met.
* Attention to Detail — Produce and review work carefully for accuracy, completeness, and consistency to ensure high standards.
* Communication — Share information, ideas, and expectations clearly and persuasively, and adapt style and content to the audience for understanding and impact.
* Customer Orientation — Understand, anticipate, and meet customer needs through empathy, effective communication, and responsiveness aligned with customer priorities.
* Problem-Solving — Anticipate and define problems, analyse root causes, evaluate alternatives, and implement practical, timely actions to resolve issues effectively.
* Software-Specific Competencies — Learn and apply relevant software and digital tools effectively to support processes, data management, and decision-making.
* Teamwork — Work cooperatively with others, communicate openly, support colleagues, manage conflict constructively, and focus on shared goals for collective results.

**What We Offer**
At ZDHC, we believe that a fulfilling career goes beyond a competitive salary. We are committed to creating a supportive and inspiring workplace where you feel valued, energised, and empowered to do your best work. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your growth, help you achieve your goals, and encourage strong connections with your team.
  
  

* 30 holidays a year, based on 40 hours a week
* Gym membership allowance - for your physical wellbeing
* Access to Open Up - for your mental wellbeing
* Hybrid and flexible working environment
* Support in setting up your workstation at home (if needed)
* High-speed internet costs reimbursed
* Working abroad development experience - the opportunity to work abroad from one of our offices for 1-3 months (after 1 year)
* MacBook and iphone

In addition, there are regional benefits, depending on the location of hire. Those will be discussed during the interview process.
  
  
Want to make an impact? Join a small, multicultural and purpose-driven team at a pivotal moment for ZDHC. You’ll help shape the evolution of the Roadmap to Zero Programme and drive meaningful change across the global textile and footwear sector, working collaboratively with colleagues across cultures, locations and time zones through remote and online ways of working.
  
  
**IMPORTANT NOTE**
**Our preference is for a candidate living and working in Thane/Mumbai. This hiring process does not include visa sponsorship or a relocation package.**
**To apply: Please submit your CV and a 1-page motivation letter in PDF.**

title: Technical Customer Support Professional II
description:
**Empower Structural Innovation as a Technical Support Professional – Tekla Structures (Concrete, Precast, & Rebar)**
Are you a customer-focused structural professional who loves deconstructing complex software challenges? Trimble is seeking a high-caliber Technical Support Professional to join our dedicated Customer Support network. In this high-impact position, you will serve as the premier point of contact for enterprise clients navigating advanced workflows within
**Tekla Structures**
, specifically focusing on the Concrete, Precast, and Rebar modules. Your immediate technical expertise will ensure engineering and detailing teams around the world minimize downtime and achieve structural precision.
  
  
**About Us**
Dedicated to the world’s tomorrow, Trimble is a technology company delivering solutions that enable our customers to work in new ways to measure, build, grow and move goods for a better quality of life. Core technologies in positioning, modeling, connectivity and data analytics connect the digital and physical worlds to improve productivity, quality, safety, transparency and sustainability. From purpose-built products and enterprise lifecycle solutions to industry cloud services, Trimble is transforming critical industries such as construction, geospatial, agriculture and transportation to power an interconnected world of work. For more information about Trimble (NASDAQ: TRMB), visit: www.trimble.com
  
  
**Our Product Ecosystem:**
Tekla software solutions are the global standard for advanced Building Information Modeling (BIM) and structural engineering. From massive cast-in-place concrete structures to complex precast components and high-density reinforcement detailing, Tekla drives structural lifecycle efficiency from design to the job site.
  
  
**What Makes This Role Great**
In this role, you will transition from a day-to-day detailer or modeller into a highly valued structural subject matter expert. Operating within our state-of-the-art hubs in Chennai or Navi Mumbai, you will have the technical autonomy to reverse-engineer software anomalies, troubleshoot localized configurations, and configure cross-platform cloud integrations. You will work closely with global helpdesks and act as a crucial voice-of-the-customer, directly collaborating with Trimble’s Product Development teams to advocate for product updates and eliminate architectural bottlenecks.
  
  
Key Exciting Responsibilities
  
  

* Complex Modeling Resolution: Provide clear, step-by-step technical guidance to resolve advanced structural modeling and parametric geometry issues faced by global engineering accounts.
* Database & Catalog Orchestration: Manage, audit, and troubleshoot intricate software databases, custom reinforcement catalogs, and automated Bar Bending Schedules (BBS).
* Deliverable Configuration Support: Assist detailers in configuring and optimizing General Arrangement (GA) drawings, Cast Unit drawings, automated rebar schedules, and custom Template Editor (.tpl) reports.
* Environment Architecture Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve localized company environment bugs, including custom parametric components, complex drawing layouts, custom attributes, and enterprise firm/project folder paths.
* Cloud & Interoperability Engineering: Support collaborative cloud workspaces by resolving interoperability bottlenecks across Trimble Connect, Tekla Model Sharing, and open BIM data exchanges (IFC, DWG, DXF, BVBS).
* Bug Replication & Product Escalation: Systematically replicate user-reported software errors, document system limitations, and escalate unresolved code defects to global development teams while populating internal knowledge bases.

**Essential Skills & Experience**

* Professional Experience: 4+ years of direct, hands-on experience utilizing or supporting Tekla Structures. Highly preferred experience operating within an RCC, Precast detailing, or high-fidelity BIM production environment.
* Technical Deep-Dive Mastery: Complete mastery of Tekla Structures software functionality, system configurations, directory folders, detailing standards, and reinforcement modules.
* Diagnostic Capabilities: Strong analytical and diagnostic skills with a proven capability to investigate system logs, reverse-engineer software errors, and troubleshoot severe system crashes under pressure.
* Communication & Deadline Focus: Exceptional, patient, and highly professional written and verbal communication skills to deliver technical solutions clearly to users working under strict engineering deadlines.
* Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering.

**Bonus Points For**

* Workflow Automation Tooling: Practical knowledge or script exposure to Tekla Open API, C#, or Grasshopper for parametric workflow automation.
* Advanced Component Customization: Direct experience developing complex parametric Custom Components and custom software macros.
* Cross-Domain Competency: Prior structural background or foundational workflow knowledge in structural steel detailing and fabrication logic.

**Logistics**

* Locations: Chennai or Navi Mumbai, India
* Department: Customer Support / Technical Services
* Job Type: Full-Time

Why You'll Love Working With Us
  
  
At Trimble, we're not just a company that "does good"—we are a team dedicated to making a tangible, positive Real-World Impact. We build innovative solutions designed to solve the world's most critical challenges. title: D&T Analyst II – Corporate Services
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**
You'll own the systems that keep our people and sites safe — badge access, video surveillance, and visitor management — across General Mills locations worldwide.
  
  
You'll work hands-on with vendors, integrators, and site teams to plan upgrades, troubleshoot issues, and bring new systems online.
  
  
You'll be a trusted go-to partner, giving you visibility and influence well beyond a typical technical support role.
  
  
Ownership, strong relationships, and work that directly protects people, this role gives you that every day.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Administer and maintain Badge Access Control systems (e.g., AMAG), including panel and reader configuration, credentialing, and access group management across global facilities.
* Configure, commission, and troubleshoot CCTV/Video Surveillance systems (e.g., Milestone) to ensure continuous coverage and platform stability.
* Manage and enhance Visitor Access Management platforms (e.g., SPLAN) to keep visitor workflows secure, efficient, and aligned with site requirements.
* Support and refine site-specific Physical Security configurations to keep systems compliant with enterprise security standards.
* Own and maintain technical documentation, device inventories, IP/network mappings, and as-built diagrams for every site.
* Act as the technical liaison with security integrators and vendors that includes statement-of-work validation, service reviews, deliverable acceptance, and escalation of recurring deficiencies during installations, upgrades, and service delivery,
* Coordinate with site and facilities teams to plan project timelines, access windows, and on-site logistics for security deployments.
* Monitor and maintain integrations between Physical Security platforms and enterprise systems.
* Triage, escalate, and resolve incidents related to access control, video surveillance, and visitor management, ensuring timely acknowledgment and resolution per defined SLAs.
* Ensure platform performance, cybersecurity, and adherence to physical security best practices and compliance requirements.
* Collaborate with Global Security and Corporate Services stakeholders to identify improvement opportunities and implement incremental enhancements.
* Research, evaluate, and pilot proof-of-concepts for new security hardware and software capabilities to expand platform value.
* Partner with Solution Managers, Product Owners, and business stakeholders to refine backlog priorities and translate requirements into technical specifications.
* Support system upgrades, firmware/software patching, and device replacements, ensuring minimal disruption to site operations.
* Maintain lifecycle and asset-management records, including warranties, spares, end-of-life status, replacement and system upgrade planning.
* Create SOPs, runbooks, and training materials and provide knowledge transfer to site security and facilities teams.
* Provide dedicated coverage during rotational night shift hours (7:00 PM – 4:00 AM India time) to support real-time monitoring, escalations, and time-sensitive vendor/site coordination.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 8+ years of overall IT experience and 5+ years of overall Physical Security experience, with hands-on experience configuring and supporting Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Visitor Management systems.
* Experience administering Access Control platforms (e.g., AMAG or similar), including panel/reader configuration, credentialing, and access group management.
* Hands-on experience with Video Management Systems (e.g., Milestone or similar), including camera commissioning, network configuration, and troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with Visitor Management platforms (e.g., SPLAN or similar) and visitor workflow configuration.
* Experience with system integrations and data interfaces, such as APIs, identity/directory services, HR systems, badging systems, visitor management, and monitoring platforms.
* Working knowledge of IP networking fundamentals (IP addressing, VLANs, network diagrams) and ability to create and maintain technical documentation and as-built diagrams.
* Experience coordinating with security integrators, hardware/software vendors, and site/facilities teams on installation and service delivery.
* Strong incident management skills, with the ability to triage, escalate, and resolve issues within defined SLAs.
* Knowledge of Physical Security Infrastructure, including controllers, readers, locks, door hardware, video servers, PoE, cabling, UPS, and low-voltage design.
* Knowledge of security system compliance, cybersecurity, and industry best practices for access control and surveillance systems.
* Detail-oriented with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently across multiple global sites.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate with stakeholders, translate business requirements into technical solutions, and manage external vendor relationships.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical security issues to nontechnical stakeholders.
* Willingness and flexibility to work rotational night shift hours (7:00 PM – 4:00 AM India time) to support global site coverage.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field
* Relevant certifications in physical security systems (e.g., AMAG, Milestone, or equivalent) preferred.

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Senior Network Infrastructure Engineer
description:
NVIDIA is looking for a Network Operations Engineer to support and maintain our cloud network infrastructure. This network serves the needs across the whole software stack for NVIDIA, from Graphics Drivers to Autonomous Vehicles and Artificial Intelligence. In this role, the Network Operations Engineer will remediate critical alerts within defined SLAs, triage production impacting network incidents, and interact with internal customers on network related issues. They will also be responsible for engaging with external vendors to remediate hardware and software issues, and participate in project related work such as network device upgrades and capacity augmentations. An ideal candidate will possess a wide range of skills, including alert monitoring & resolution in large-scale networks and CSP environments, outstanding troubleshooting skills, understanding of L3 underlay networks, and network protocol knowledge in large multi-vendor infrastructures.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**

* Engage in 24/7 global shift rotations to provide remote support for network repairs and changes while collaborating across teams and updating customers on status and ticket information.
* Drive operational improvements in change management and daily operations by following procedures.
* Manage and operate large scale IP network technologies and infrastructures.
* Utilise your skills in Peering and Datacenter interconnect technologies: PNI, Transit, Exchange, Passive DWDM, Wave circuits.
* Monitor and support the network health of on-premises and cloud infrastructures.
* Collaborate and develop workflow enhancements while documenting best practices.

**What We Need To See**

* Deep knowledge and experience of TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, MPLS, IS-IS, VxLAN, EVPN, QoS, GRE, IPsec, DNS, and MACsec.
* Over 4 years of experience in network operations.
* Skilled in network troubleshooting techniques and leveraging creative problem-solving abilities.
* Strong track record of alert response within defined SLAs and Incident management.
* Experience with one or more of the following CSP environments: AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI.
* Familiarity with Arista, Fortinet and Juniper.
* Hands-on experience with contributing to tooling and automation for provisioning, monitoring, and managing complex network infrastructures.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Strong background of Mellanox/Cumulus OS.
* Working knowledge of Infiniband technology.
* Skilled in Unix/Linux system administration, with the ability to write and understand Python/Shell scripts to enhance productivity in hyperscale environments.
* Familiarity with leveraging tools such as Netbox/Nautobot, Prometheus, Grafana, Panoptes to monitor and manage a global network.
* Passionate about innovating and investing in ground breaking technologies.

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hard-working people in the world working for us. Are you creative and autonomous? Do you love a challenge? If so, we want to hear from you.
  
  
NVIDIA is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

The IT Helpdesk role provides Level 1/2 end-user on-site and remote support to agency end users in a predominantly Mac OS environment in the country. This includes end-user support to VVIP and other senior executives on-site. This role provides audio-visual support as needed for high-visibility meetings on-site, as well as advanced smart-hands support as needed to support other Omnicom IT centralized services. The role requires flexibility and adaptability to supporting multiple agencies in the region and supporting “ad-hoc” or otherwise custom support as needed.
  
  
The ideal candidate has 5+ years of IT end-user support experience desktop, mobile device , and audio-visual support.
  
  
**Essential Functions**

* Provides executive and VVIP support and audio visual (AV) support.
* Provide quality assurance over any 3rd party IT services provided on-site.
* Facilitate and coordinate site-specific activities (e.g., office moves, weekend power downs) as needed.
* Support “ad-hoc” agency IT support as needed and directed by the IT Support Manager.
* Works directly with internal and external 3rd party resources to ensure that end-user issues are resolved efficiently.
* Manage the end-user experience delivered to agency end-users on-site and remote in the region.
* Provide Level 1/2 end-user on-site support to agency end users, including troubleshooting, resolving, and documenting issues with desktop, laptop, mobile device, printer, and peripheral hardware and software.
* Maintain rapport with agency end-users and be a go-to resource for IT troubleshooting.
* Provide end-user support to VVIP and other senior executives on-site, including setting up, configuring, and testing devices, applications, and network connectivity.
* Engage IT Support Manager(s) as needed to identify systemic issues with end-user support.
* Maintain asset inventory and track IT hardware in the region.
* Follow Omnicom IT policies, procedures, and standards for end-user support and service delivery. And report any violations of Omnicom security policies to management.
* Provide attended meeting support for high-visibility internal and external meetings.
* Provide “ad-hoc” or otherwise custom IT support to agencies, while also documenting the support requirements for review as a consolidation opportunity for Omnicom IT centralized services.
* Provide advanced smart-hands support on-site, supporting other Omnicom IT centralized services that may not have an on-site presence.
* Support cross-functional IT processes such as onboarding, offboarding, device replacement, incident resolution and request fulfillment.
* Use ServiceNow ITSM platform to receive and manage incident and request tickets, maintaining proper ticket management protocols such as detailed comments and close notes.
* Manage assigned tickets to complete within service level criteria.

Individual must also maintain an extreme level of confidentiality in dealing with all information that flows through the office.

* 5+ years of IT end-user support experience desktop, mobile device, and audio-visual support.
* Strong technical knowledge and skills in Mac OS
* In-depth knowledge of end-user platforms and services, including but not limited to, MacOS, Office365, Windows OS, Active Directory, etc., current desktop and mobile computing technology, core media business applications and their operation.
* Familiarity with networking concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN).
* Excellent customer service, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Must possess a “can-do” attitude and be ready to roll up their sleeves to get the job done.
* Ability to function within a group and support other team members to resolve problems.
* Ability to quickly analyze problems, interpret operational needs, and resolve or escalate problems in a timely manner as well as ability to provide real time support for end-user issues.
* Ability to work calmly under high pressure situations.
* Ability to maintain good rapport with agencies being supported.
* Ability to communicate with executives and their staff.
* Ability to prioritize and work on multiple tasks simultaneously.
* Ability to train others in the use and support of Omnicom business systems.

title: IT & Security Operations Lead
description:
**Who We Are**

ParamAIQ is an applied-AI company building NyaayOS, the reasoning layer for Indian law. We turn the primary sources of Indian law, from the BNS, BNSS and BSA to decades of Supreme Court and High Court precedent, into something any advocate can stand on. Work that took days takes minutes.

India has more than 55 million pending cases, and the outcome for a litigant can turn on who they can afford. We're building the foundation that gives an independent lawyer the same analytical leverage as a partner at a leading firm, and we build it with practising lawyers, not just for them.

**Why This Role Matters**

Today we run on Microsoft 365 and Slack with no central identity platform, no device management baseline, no formal service desk, and no security framework. There is no Active Directory. This is not a role that inherits a mature estate and governs it.

This is a build role first and a governance role second. In your first year you'll design and stand up the identity, endpoint, network and security foundations for the whole group, and then run them well. You'll have one engineer working to you from day one, real budget, and a direct line to the CTO. You'll also be hands-on: at our size, the person who designs conditional access is the same person who occasionally re-images a laptop.

**What You'll Own**

* Identity & access: Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory as the group's authoritative identity source. SSO, MFA, conditional access, RBAC, privileged access, joiner-mover-leaver, and periodic access reviews.
* Microsoft 365: Tenant administration and governance, Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, licensing optimisation, multi-entity and multi-domain design, and security baselines.
* Slack: End-to-end administration (Teams chat is deliberately disabled). SSO and SCIM from Entra ID, retention and eDiscovery, DLP, app approval, and guest governance.
* Endpoint management: A mixed Windows and macOS fleet of roughly 100 devices. Intune, Apple Business Manager with zero-touch enrolment, FileVault escrow, and a macOS patching approach of your recommendation.
* Security operations: SPF, DKIM and DMARC across all domains, endpoint protection, vulnerability posture, phishing simulation and awareness training, shadow-IT discovery, secrets hygiene, and an incident response runbook you've actually rehearsed.
* Compliance & audit: IT controls evidence for SOC 2, IT's obligations under India's DPDP Act including breach notification readiness, the asset register, e-waste rules, and access control and CCTV administration.
* Infrastructure & network: Firewall, VPN, Wi-Fi and ISPs, the new Mumbai office comms room and cabling handover, and the physical environment for on-premises GPU infrastructure (power, cooling, access, encryption at rest).
* Backup, DR & continuity: Backup standards, defined recovery objectives, restores tested on a schedule, and documented continuity procedures.
* Service management: Select and run our first ticketing system, publish SLAs, direct the Network & Helpdesk Engineer's work, and own major incident escalation.
* Vendors & budget: Microsoft partners, ISPs, hardware and SaaS vendors. Contracts, renewals, endpoint procurement, vendor security reviews, and input into the annual IT budget.

**What Success Looks Like in Year One**

We'll judge this role on outcomes, not activity. By the end of your first twelve months we expect:

* Identity is authoritative: Entra ID and Active Directory deployed, everyone provisioned from a single source, and SSO live for our top applications including Slack
* MFA and conditional access at 100%: No exceptions without a documented, time-bound approval
* Every device managed: 100% of Windows and macOS endpoints enrolled, encrypted, patch-compliant and in a single inventory
* Joiner-mover-leaver is a process, not a favour: Documented, measured against an SLA, with offboarding that reliably revokes access on the day it should
* A service desk exists: Ticketing live, SLAs published, and a baseline satisfaction measure
* Recovery is proven, not assumed: At least one full documented restore test for each critical system
* Audit-ready: SOC 2 IT evidence produced on a defined schedule, and DPDP obligations mapped to owners
* The estate is documented: Asset register, network documentation, and runbooks your engineer can work from without you

**Scope Boundary**

* You own corporate IT: identity, endpoints, the corporate network, SaaS, and the physical technology environment, including power, cooling, access control and encryption for our on-premises GPU hardware.
* Engineering owns production cloud infrastructure, the build and deployment pipeline, and the product environment. You're consulted on those and own identity and access into them, but you're not the approver for production change.
* Where the boundary is genuinely unclear, raise it rather than either annexing or ignoring it.

**What You Bring**

* You've personally built a Microsoft identity platform from nothing, with Entra ID and Active Directory designed, deployed and cut over, not just administered one someone else built
* Deep, hands-on Microsoft 365 tenant administration: Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, licensing, security baselines and conditional access
* Real endpoint management across Windows and macOS, including Intune and Apple Business Manager, and opinions about managing Macs properly
* You've carried SOC 2, ISO 27001 or an equivalent framework as the person who produced the IT evidence, not a bystander to the audit
* Comfortable being hands-on and hands-off in the same day: architecture in the morning, a stuck user in the afternoon, without resenting either
* You can lead one engineer well: allocate work, review it honestly, and grow them
* Patience with non-technical users in a trading business and a biotech who don't think in tickets

**Bonus Points**

* Slack administration at organisation scale: SCIM, retention, DLP, eDiscovery, app governance
* Multi-entity or multi-company tenant design, including data segregation and per-entity licensing and cost allocation
* Familiarity with India's DPDP Act as it applies to IT operations
* Commissioning a new office: comms room, structured cabling, access control and CCTV integration
* Exposure to on-premises GPU or high-density compute environments
* Working fluency in Hindi or Marathi alongside English

**What You Get**

* A true build opportunity: design the group's identity, endpoint, network and security foundations from scratch
* One engineer working to you from day one, and real budget
* A direct line to the CTO
* Group-wide scope across trading, biotech and legal tech, including the infrastructure behind India's agentic legal AI

title: Data Center Technician III
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Experience with diagnosing and troubleshooting operating systems, computer hardware and server hardware and experience with networking protocols.
* Experience with assembly of mechanical or electrical systems, or performing component-level repairs and troubleshooting on technical equipment.
* Ability to work non-standard hours, including working weekends, night shifts, holidays and on shift-based schedules as required.
* Ability to lift/move 50lb (23kg) of equipment and ability to exert yourself physically over extended periods of time, including frequent bending, kneeling, climbing, pushing/pulling and lifting.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 4 years of experience in maintenance and monitoring of server systems.
* 2 years of experience in troubleshooting hardware and network issues using Linux tools (e.g., LPIC-1, CCNA).
* Proven experience in maintenance of server and storage systems.
* Experience working within a data center or network operation center environment.

**About The Job**
Google isn't just a software company. The Hardware Operations team is responsible for monitoring the state-of-the-art physical infrastructure behind Google's powerful search technology. As an Operations Technician, you'll install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software (like Google's Linux cluster). You'll also take on the configuration of more complex components such as networks, routers, hubs, bridges, switches and networking protocols. You'll participate in or lead small project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans. A typical day involves manual movement and installation of racks, and while it can sometimes be physically demanding, you are excited to work with infrastructure that is at the cutting-edge of computer technology.
  
  
As a Data Center Technician for our Google Cloud region, your duties range from the physical deployment of technology to working closely with various stakeholders. You will ensure that our goals, missions and projects are successfully delivered, and, more importantly, that they are repeatable across our global array of data centers. A typical day involves movement and installation of equipment, and while it can sometimes be physically demanding, you will work with computer technology to ensure quality and reliability.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Install, configure, test, troubleshoot, and repair advanced server hardware and server software.
* Manage and set up complex network components, including routers, bridges, and switches.
* Lead or contribute to local installation projects, create contingency plans, and collaborate with stakeholders.
* Ensure mission goals and deployments are reliably executed and repeatable across Google's global data center network.
* Manage equipment movement and installation to uphold data center quality and operational uptime.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

description:

L1 Infrastructure Support Engineer

2–3 Years

Full-time

1 Resource
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented
**L1 Infrastructure Support Engineer**
to manage day-to-day IT infrastructure operations, monitoring, and level-1 support. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring high availability, performance, and security of Windows/Linux operating systems, hypervisors, networks, backups, and storage environments while adhering to SLA-based service delivery.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**1. OS Administration & System Health**

* Perform day-to-day administration and health checks for Windows Server and Linux operating systems.
* Execute scheduled OS patching, security updates, and assist in vulnerability remediation.
* Perform basic Hyper-V health checks, monitoring, and routine administration.
* Incident Management & L1 Support
* Provide L1 troubleshooting for infrastructure-related incidents and service requests within defined SLAs.
* Conduct application-level support and coordinate with technical teams for swift incident resolution.
* Escalate complex or unresolved issues to L2 Support, OEM Vendors, or Application Development Teams with clear diagnostic reports.
* Infrastructure & Backup Monitoring
* Continuously monitor servers, storage arrays, network devices, security tools, and virtualization platforms.
* Oversee scheduled backup processes, verify backup success/failure logs, and coordinate remediation for failed jobs.

We are hiring Microsoft 365 L1 Support Engineers to provide first-level technical assistance for Microsoft 365 applications and end-user issues. The role involves basic administration, incident resolution, ticket management, and escalation of complex issues to L2/L3 support teams.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Provide L1 support for Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, and OneDrive.
  
  
Handle user creation, password resets, license assignment, group management, and basic Microsoft Entra ID administration.
  
  
Support Microsoft Intune device onboarding, enrollment, and basic troubleshooting.
  
  
Troubleshoot Outlook configuration, mailbox access, email delivery, Teams login and calling, and OneDrive synchronization issues.
  
  
Manage basic shared mailbox, distribution list, and user access requests according to approved processes.
  
  
Log, track, update, and resolve incidents and service requests within defined SLAs.
  
  
Escalate complex technical issues to L2/L3 teams with appropriate troubleshooting details.
  
  
Maintain ticket documentation, troubleshooting records, and knowledge-base articles.
  
  
Provide timely updates to users and ensure a positive end-user support experience.
  
  
**Required Skills**
Basic knowledge of Microsoft 365 / Office 365 administration.
  
  
Understanding of Exchange Online, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint Online, and OneDrive.
  
  
Familiarity with user creation, password resets, licensing, and group administration.
  
  
Basic understanding of Microsoft Entra ID and Microsoft Intune.
  
  
Experience with ticketing tools, incident management, and SLA-based support.
  
  
Good communication, troubleshooting, and customer service skills.
  
  
Preferred Experience: Experience in an IT help desk, service desk, or L1 technical support environment.
  
  
Skills: microsoft 365,customer service,entra id,communication

title: DHS Technical Services Specialist
description:
**With a passion for life**
Join our diverse teams of passionate people and a career that allows you to develop both personally and professionally. At Getinge we exist to make life-saving technology accessible for more people. To make a true difference for our customers – and to save more lives, we need team players, forward thinkers, and game changers.
  
  
Are you looking for an inspiring career? You just found it.
  
  
**Job Overview**
As a Digital Health Solutions (DHS) Technical Services Specialist for T-DOC and Tegris, your primary focus will be on managing project planning, installation, and aftersales services for hospital clients in Southeast Asia and India. You will deliver these activities directly or in collaboration with partners and distributors to ensure solutions are implemented in compliance with company standards and regulatory requirements, while achieving the highest level of customer satisfaction.
  
  
**Project Implementation**
**Job Responsibilities and Essential Duties**

* Manage project implementations from planning through installation, testing and commissioning (T&C), and final handover.
* Conduct comprehensive user training sessions following successful installation to ensure effective and proficient system utilization.
* Maintain thorough documentation for all project phases, including customer milestone sign-offs and acceptance records.

**After Sales Support**

* Perform system maintenance, software updates, and upgrades, either remotely or on-site as required.
* Provide timely and effective after sales support by identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving customer issues.
* Maintain detailed documentation of all ongoing service issues in the local system, including issue descriptions, resolutions, and follow-up actions.
* Carry out all activities in accordance with company protocols and regulatory requirements.

**Service Level Agreements (SLAs)**

* Prepare SLAs in line with company standards and customer requirements.
* Ensure customer requests are fulfilled within the agreed timelines and conditions defined in the SLAs.
* Support upselling opportunities with existing customers by identifying potential needs and providing consultative recommendations.

**Technical Support To Sales Team As And When Required**

* Provide technical support to the Sales team during quotation and tender phases by proposing cost-effective solutions that meet customer needs and requirements.
* Support the Sales team with technical presentations and product demonstrations, ensuring clear and effective communication of product and service features and benefits.

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
* At least 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in healthcare IT, network, or digital health solutions.
* Experience with healthcare integration projects and clinical workflows is highly desirable.
* Experience troubleshooting software, hardware, and network-connected systems.
* Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal.

**Required Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**

* Healthcare IT systems, digital health solutions, and hospital workflows
* Hospital Information Systems (HIS), Electronic Medical Records (EMR/EHR), and systems integration.
* Hospital interoperability standards and protocols.
* Experience working within CSSD (Central Sterile Services Department) and Operating Room (OR) environments.
* Networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, VPN, LAN/WAN).
* Server administration and SQL.
* Windows operating systems, software deployment, and system integration.
* Service management, SLAs, and regulatory/compliance requirements.

**Skills**

* Technical troubleshooting and problem resolution.
* Project management and implementation coordination.
* Customer training and technical presentations.
* Documentation, reporting, and stakeholder management.
* Strong communication and customer-facing skills.

**Abilities**

* Manage projects independently from planning through customer acceptance.
* Work collaboratively with sales teams, customers, distributors, and partners.
* Communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Prioritize multiple tasks while maintaining high customer satisfaction.
* Identify service improvement and upselling opportunities.
* Ability to forge and maintain relationships with customers.

**About Us**
With a firm belief that every person and community should have access to the best possible care, Getinge provides hospitals and life science institutions with products and solutions aiming to improve clinical results and optimize workflows. The offering includes products and solutions for intensive care, cardiovascular procedures, operating rooms, sterile reprocessing and life science. Getinge employs over 12,000 people worldwide and the products are sold in more than 135 countries.
  
  
Reasonable accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

title: IT Service Management
description:
**At Chain IQ, your ideas move fast.**
Chain IQ is a global AI-driven Procurement Service Partner, headquartered in Baar, Switzerland, with operations across main centers and 16 offices worldwide. We provide tailored, end-to-end procurement solutions that enable transformation, drive scalability, and deliver substantial reductions in our clients' indirect spend. Our culture is built on innovation, entrepreneurship, ownership, and impact. Here, your voice matters - bold thinking is encouraged, and action follows ambition.
  
  
We are seeking a dynamic IT Service Management professional who thrives in a multifaceted role supporting the transition and ongoing operations of our AI-driven digital procurement platform. This role is ideal for a hands-on professional who combines strong IT Service Management expertise with application support, automation, low-code development, and operational excellence.
  
  
The successful candidate will be responsible for managing incidents, service requests, platform operations, and service improvements while driving automation initiatives that reduce ticket volumes, improve user experience, and increase operational efficiency. We are looking for a self-starter who takes ownership, proactively identifies opportunities for improvement, and collaborates effectively across business and technology teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop a strong understanding of Chain IQ’s digital platforms, business processes, integrations, and service offerings supporting Source-to-Pay (S2P) operations.
* Manage and coordinate end-to-end IT Service Management activities, including Incident Management, Problem Management, Service Request Fulfilment, Knowledge Management, and Service Level Management.
* Provide Level 3 application support by diagnosing, troubleshooting, and resolving complex business application issues while ensuring SLA compliance and customer satisfaction.
* Analyse incident and service request trends, identify recurring issues, and drive permanent resolutions through root cause analysis and problem management practices.
* Design, develop, and maintain low-code/no-code solutions, workflows, automations, and self-service capabilities.
* Support AI Ops and intelligent automation initiatives by leveraging analytics, predictive insights, workflow automation, virtual agents, and AI-powered operational capabilities to reduce manual effort and improve service quality.
* Lead initiatives to reduce ticket volumes through automation, process optimization, knowledge management, self-healing capabilities, and proactive monitoring.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders and technical teams to identify improvement opportunities and translate operational challenges into scalable technology solutions.
* Monitor platform health, integration performance, system alerts, and operational metrics to proactively identify risks and service degradation.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, operational runbooks, knowledge articles, support procedures, and service management artifacts.
* Demonstrate ownership and accountability by independently driving operational improvements, solving problems proactively, and delivering measurable business outcomes.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Information Technology, Business Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Minimum 6 years of experience in IT Service Management, Application Support, Service Operations, or Service Delivery functions.
* Strong understanding of ITIL processes, including Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, Release Management, and Service Request Management.
* Knowledge of AI Ops, event monitoring, predictive analytics, and automation frameworks.
* Experience working with low-code/no-code platforms.
* Knowledge of service management platforms and experience managing service tickets, SLAs, and operational processes.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills across applications, integrations, APIs, and data flows.
* Experience with REST APIs, JSON, web services, and system integrations.
* Working knowledge of SQL and data analysis techniques for investigation and reporting.
* Self-starter with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Ability to independently manage priorities and drive initiatives with minimal supervision.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and collaboration skills.
* Excellent problem-solving and critical thinking abilities.
* Experience supporting AI-enabled digital platforms and automation-led service organizations.
* Understanding of Service Integration and Management (SIAM), Agile delivery methodologies, and continuous improvement practices.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and customer-service orientation.
* Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.
* ITIL Foundation Certification (mandatory).

**Join a truly global team.**
We offer a dynamic and international environment where high performance meets real purpose. We're proud to be Great Place to Work-certified and even prouder of the people who make that possible. Let’s shape the future of procurement - together.
  
  
**Chain IQ – Create. Lead. Make an impact.**

title: Salesforce System Administrator
description:
Job Type: Permanent - Full Time
  
  
Location: Mumbai
  
  
Job Category: IT
  
  
**Job Description**
Zurich Cover-More Group helps people travel safely across the globe every day. We are there at every step of a traveller’s journey, to keep them safe and help them out if something goes wrong. We are committed to providing reliable, fast, flexible and bespoke services for our customers as well as the many well-known brands we partner with, such as travel agencies, airlines, banks and major sporting clubs!
  
  
In the post-pandemic world, travel insurance is more important than ever. We are committed to delivering an exceptional service for our customers and we want you to be part of that journey.
  
  
**So, what’s the job?**

* You'll provide day-to-day Level 2 support for the Salesforce platform, ensuring timely resolution of user issues and platform-related requests.
* You'll configure and customize Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud, including creating and maintaining dashboards and reports based on business requirements.
* You'll monitor Salesforce logs and proactively identify, troubleshoot, and remediate bugs and system issues.
* You'll act as the primary point of contact for Salesforce-related queries, providing end-user support and ad hoc training when needed.
* You'll collaborate with Salesforce users to gather feedback, understand pain points, and recommend platform enhancements.
* You'll assist users with production verification testing and user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure successful deployment of changes.
* You'll support the testing team by participating in Salesforce regression testing for new releases and system updates.
* You'll manage Salesforce data and database integrity, including data cleansing, sandbox preparation, backup and restore activities, object optimization, and security settings.
* You'll maintain the overall health and security of the Salesforce org, including applying security updates, managing certificates, and ensuring platform stability

**And what are we looking for?**

* You'll hold a relevant qualification in IT, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline.

title: Technical Account Manager, ES - INDIA
description:
**Description**
AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  
  
Amazon has built a global reputation for being the most customer-centric company, a company that customers from all over the world recognize, value, and trust for both our products and services. Amazon has a fast-paced environment where we “Work Hard, Have Fun and Make History.”
  
  
As an increasing number of enterprises move their critical systems to the cloud, AWS India is in need of highly efficient technical consulting talent to help our largest and strategically important customers navigate the operational challenges and complexities of AWS Cloud. We are looking for Technical Consultants to support our customers creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Data Analytics, Application services, Networking, Server-less and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor for organizations ranging from start-ups to large enterprises.
  
  
As a Technical Account Manager, you will be the primary technical point of contact for one or more customers helping to plan, debug, and oversee ongoing operations of business-critical applications. You will get your hands dirty, troubleshooting application, network, database, and architectural challenges using a suite of internal AWS Cloud tools as well as your existing knowledge and toolkits. We are seeking individuals with strong backgrounds in I.T. Consulting and in any of these related areas such as Solution Designing, Application and System Development, Database Management, Big Data and Analytics, DevOps Consulting, and Media technologies. Knowledge of programming and scripting is beneficial to the role.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Every day will bring new and exciting challenges on the job while you:
  
  

* Learn and use Cloud technologies.
* Interact with leading technologists around the world.
* Work on critical, highly complex customer problems that may span multiple AWS Cloud services.
* Apply advanced troubleshooting techniques to provide unique solutions to our customers' individual needs.
* Work directly with AWS Cloud subject matter experts to help reproduce and resolve customer issues.
* Write tutorials, how-to videos, and other technical articles for the customer community.
* Leverage your extensive customer support experience and provide feedback to internal AISPL teams on how to improve our services.
* Drive projects that improve support-related processes and our customers’ technical support experience.
* Assist in Design/Architecture of AWS and Hybrid cloud solutions.
* Help Enterprises define IT and business processes that work well with cloud deployments.
* Be available outside of business hours to help coordinate the handling of urgent issues as needed.

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree
* Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, engineering, analytics, mathematics, statistics, IT or equivalent, or Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
* 7+ years of hands-on infrastructure, troubleshooting, systems administration, networking, DevOps or applications development experience
* Experience in external enterprise customer-facing role as a technical lead, with strong oral and written communication skills, presenting to both large and small audiences
* Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time
* Be mobile and travel to client locations as needed.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer-facing environment as a technical lead

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

**About Monster Energy**
Forget about blending in. That's not our style. We're the risk takers, the trailblazers, the gamechangers. We're not perfect and we don't pretend to be. We're raw, unfiltered, and a bit unconventional. Our drive is just like our athletes, unrivaled. The power is in your hands to define what success looks like and where you want to take your career. It's not just about what we do, but about who we become on along the way. We are much more than a brand here. We are a way of life, a mindset. Join us.
  
  
**A Day In The Life**
As a
**Desktop Support Analyst - APAC**
, you'll be the front-line force keeping our teams powered up and connected across the region. You'll deliver hands-on and remote technical support, tackling everything from hardware and software issues to mobile devices and AV technology. When challenges are escalated from the Service Desk, you'll jump in, troubleshoot fast, and drive solutions that keep the business moving.
  
  
You'll own the end-user device lifecycle from end to end, provisioning and configuring new equipment, supporting employee onboarding, and ensuring secure recovery and disposal of assets. Partnering with users, vendors, the Service Desk, and global IT teams, you'll help maintain accurate asset records in ServiceNow and deliver a seamless, high-performance support experience across every APAC location. No matter where our employees are, you'll make sure they have the tools and support they need to perform at their best.
  
  
**The Impact You'll Make**

* Provide onsite, hands-on technical support to Monster Energy employees in the India office and remote support to users across APAC, resolving incidents and service requests escalated from the Service Desk by priority and SLA in ServiceNow.
* Diagnose, repair and resolve hardware, software and peripheral issues on Windows and macOS computers, iOS and Android devices, printers and related equipment.
* Image, deploy and configure end-user devices using Microsoft Intune, including Windows Autopilot and Apple device enrollment, and configure and replace mobile devices in coordination with users and wireless carriers.
* Manage the full device lifecycle, including new-hire setups, hardware refreshes, retrievals, reassignments and secure disposal, and support onboarding and offboarding by preparing equipment, accounts and access and giving new hires an orientation on IT tools.
* Support Microsoft 365 applications, and manage user accounts, group memberships, access and MFA in Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID.
* Set up and support meeting rooms, audio/visual equipment and Microsoft Teams Rooms devices, including executive and event support.
* Troubleshoot local wired, Wi-Fi and VPN connectivity issues, identify and escalate major incidents under incident management procedures, and work with the Network, Infrastructure and global IT teams on escalations.
* Keep an accurate inventory of IT equipment, spares and software licenses in ServiceNow, manage local IT stock and storage, and coordinate with local vendors and service providers for hardware procurement, warranty repairs and onsite services.
* Document troubleshooting steps and resolutions in ServiceNow, create and update English knowledge base articles, and train end users on company devices, applications and self-service tools.
* Take part in IT projects such as hardware refreshes, OS upgrades and office openings or relocations; travel to other APAC offices as needed; provide occasional after-hours or weekend support; and follow IT, security and local data privacy policies.

**Who You Are**

* Flexible to work 6:30 AM to 3:30 PM IST, Monday through Friday, ensuring seamless support coverage across multiple time zones and maintaining service availability during designated support hours.
* Prefer a Bachelor's Degree in the field of -- Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field
* Additional Experience Desired: Between 1-3 years of experience in Desktop support, or similar hands-on IT role in an enterprise environment
* Additional Experience Desired: Between 3-5 years of experience in supporting users across multiple countries
* Computer Skills Desired: ServiceNow ITSM and asset management. Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, and Apple device management (macOS and iOS). Microsoft 365
* Preferred Certifications: CompTIA A+, ITIL 4 Foundation, and/or Microsoft certifications (e.g., Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate) preferred
* Additional Knowledge or Skills to be Successful in this role: Fluent in English preferred. Experience supporting audio/visual and Microsoft Teams Rooms equipment. Lenovo and Apple business systems knowledge a plus

Read our privacy policy here: Privacy Policy

**About Us**

Jefferies Financial Group Inc. (‘‘Jefferies,’’ ‘‘we,’’ ‘‘us’’ or ‘‘our’’) is a U.S.-headquartered global full service, integrated investment banking and securities firm. Our largest subsidiary, Jefferies LLC, a U.S. broker-dealer, was founded in the U.S. in 1962 and our first international operating subsidiary, Jefferies International Limited, a U.K. broker-dealer, was established in the U.K. in 1986. Our strategy focuses on continuing to build out our investment banking effort, enhancing our capital markets businesses and further developing our Leucadia Asset Management alternative asset management platform. We offer deep sector expertise across a full range of products and services in investment banking, equities, fixed income, asset and wealth management in the Americas, Europe and the Middle East and Asia.

Application Support – Equity Front Office IT

Mumbai, India - Onsite

Jefferies, the global investment banking firm, has served companies and investors for over 50 years. Headquartered in New York with its European head office in London and staff in over 30 global cities, the firm provides clients with capital markets and financial advisory services, institutional brokerage and securities research, and wealth and asset management. Jefferies provides research and execution services in equity, fixed income, foreign exchange, futures and commodities markets, and a full range of investment banking services including underwriting, merger and acquisition, restructuring and recapitalization.

Responsibilities:

* Part of the growing trading support team in Asia supporting APAC equity trading desks across Hong Kong,Japan, Sydney, Singapore and India
* Equity products covered: Cash, Portfolio Trading, DMA, DSA, Swaps and Convertible Bonds
* Part of a regional application support team to provide production support on the global equity Fidessa trading platforms and handle FIX connectivity issues related to clients, vendors and internal users
* Regional morning check-outs and primary support coverage on Hong Kong holidays
* Work closely with Asia project management and global teams on new business initiatives and priority
* Engage technical discussion with vendor and in-house developers on new Asia trading requests
* Manage vendor’s delivery schedule and progress on systems implementation and upgrades
* Co-ordinate and participate in UAT together with vendor and various internal teams and users
* Prepare application system and operation flow, user training and documentations

Experience Required:

* At least 5 years of experience in equity front office IT space with strong hands on application support, project management and business analysis skill.
* At least 3 years of experience on Order Management System application, exposure to Fidessa and India based trading platforms from OmneNest and GreekSoft would be highly regarded
* Ideally to have 3 years or more experience on FIX protocol, connectivity and order routing application, preferably ULLink order routing platform
* Project management and implementation experience in regional front office trading platform for Asia markets a definite plus•Have clear understanding of Japan and Asian equities order flow life cycle
* Familiar with trading system workflow on both high-touch (single stock, basket trading, swap, converts) and low-touch (DMA and Algo) trading
* APAC market knowledge e.g. investor ID, auction mechanism, short sell rules an added advantage
* Able to independently manage multiple tasks, detail oriented, proactive, good sense of ownership and urgency
* A strong team player able to collaborate smoothly with own and cross team members as well as well-versed in working with equity front office users at various locations with a global driven technology operation model
* Highly competent and effective in both verbal and written communication in English

Jefferies is an equal employment opportunity employer, and takes affirmative action to ensure that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, gender, pregnancy, age, physical or mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, genetic information, reproductive health decisions, or any other factor protected by applicable law. We are committed to hiring the most qualified applicants and complying with all federal, state, and local equal employment opportunity laws. As part of this commitment, Jefferies will extend reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities, as required by applicable law.

title: Senior Associate - Atlassian Workplace Platforms
description:
Your Team Responsibilities
  
  
The Atlassian Platform team owns the governance, configuration, and continuous improvement of MSCI’s Atlassian Cloud environment — Jira Software, Confluence, Jira Product Discovery, and Rovo — which serves as the operational backbone for approximately two-thirds of MSCI’s global workforce. We keep the platform reliable, well-governed, and strategically aligned with how MSCI works. Beyond keeping the lights on, we are the internal centre of expertise for what the Atlassian platform can do — including its rapidly expanding AI capabilities — and how to use those capabilities in ways that are practical, cost-justified, and genuinely useful to the teams that depend on us.
  
  
We are establishing a presence in Mumbai to extend our operational coverage into the APAC timezone and build a trusted platform relationship with MSCI’s India-based stakeholder community. This role is that presence. You will enter through deep operational immersion — learning how a regulated financial technology firm uses Atlassian at enterprise scale — and grow into a broader mandate as you demonstrate the judgment and organizational fluency to advise internal teams on how to solve their real problems using the platform, including where AI fits and where it does not.
  
  
Your Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Serve as the primary APAC point of contact for the Atlassian Platform Support queue: triaging and resolving platform requests covering Jira project setup, Confluence space configuration, API token provisioning and renewal, board configuration, permission management, and user access — handling these with both technical accuracy and clear stakeholder communication.
* Manage Atlassian REST API tokens and service account credentials for teams integrating Jira and Confluence into automation pipelines, reporting tools, and AI agents — including provisioning, expiry monitoring, rotation, and advising requestors on appropriate access scoping.
* Execute platform administration and KTLO activities: Jira and Confluence configuration maintenance, sandbox environment lifecycle management, licensing inventory support, and governance documentation — building operational depth that becomes the foundation for everything else.
* Advise internal stakeholder teams on how to solve workflow and collaboration problems within the Atlassian platform, distinguishing between requests that need configuration work, requests that could benefit from AI-assisted automation, and requests where the right answer is a simpler process rather than a new tool.
* Evaluate AI use cases within the Atlassian ecosystem — Rovo agents, AI-assisted automation rules, Confluence AI features — with a practical lens: does this use case justify its token cost, does it solve a real process problem, and is it sustainable at scale? MSCI’s Procurement function monitors AI spend, and your advisory work directly informs those cost decisions.
* Build and maintain documentation in Confluence for platform standards, support procedures, and recurring processes — progressively converting tribal knowledge into institutional knowledge accessible to the teams that need it.
* Develop working relationships with MSCI’s internal stakeholder functions — InfoSec, IT Risk, Privacy, Compliance, PMO, Product, and Finance — learning their constraints, building credibility, and becoming the person those teams trust to engage when they have a platform or AI tooling question.
* Participate in Atlassian Platform Roadmap sprint ceremonies with the Monterrey (Mexico) team, contributing operational insight from the APAC support queue to inform platform roadmap prioritization and governance decisions.

Your Growth Path
  
  
This role is support-first by design, not by limitation. The Atlassian platform at MSCI is complex, highly governed, and deeply embedded in how the firm operates. Understanding it well enough to give good advice takes time and direct exposure — and that exposure comes through the support queue.
  
  
The progression to broader platform ownership — including contribution to integration decisions, enterprise reporting, and firm-wide AI tooling advisory — is earned through a specific kind of readiness: the ability to independently navigate MSCI’s internal stakeholder landscape. You will be ready when you can engage InfoSec on API governance, work through IT Risk on platform change approvals, align with Privacy on Confluence data handling, and advise PMO, Product, and Finance on platform configuration choices without requiring escalation. The team will invest actively in getting you there.
  
  
**Your Skills And Experience That Will Help You Excel**

And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
Data Center Operations designs, installs & maintains the world’s largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure. We are looking for skilled Data Centre Linux & HW Engineer at Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (“ADSIPL”) with a passion for technology to help us expand AWS Cloud offerings to the next level.
  
  
ADSIPL offers an exciting, dynamic and challenging environment encouraging creativity and personal development while maintaining AWS computing environments in a secure, scalable, and cost-effective manner.
  
  
At ADSIPL, career progression is part of our environment. We want you to progress. If your career path is in Systems, Network or Database Engineering, Software Development or maybe AWS Support, Technical Operations or perhaps Project Management, we will create a development plan to enable you to succeed reaching those goals. This begins on Day One!
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
A Data Centre Linux & HW Engineer at ADSIPL may be the primary point of contact for both internal customers (for example: Network Engineers, Systems Engineers, Software Developers, Database Engineers, Technical Operations) and external customers (Hardware Vendors, Contractors, Service Providers among others).

A Data Centre Operation Technician at ADSIPL, expectation from role are:

A day in the life
  
  

* You will support DC (Data Center) infrastructure equipment (e.g. racks, servers, networking devices, hardware components, cables, etc.),
* You will follow the instructions ticket-based environment and work on systematic problem resolution and perform routine operation activities on hardware, or spare parts, including rack install, server break/fix, rack decom etc.

* Show a strong aptitude for troubleshooting and problem solving

* Your role involves covering 24x7 shift rotation
