title: Senior Engineer, Digital Collaboration & Messaging (Teams & Slack)
description:
Senior Enterprise Systems Engineer (Teams & Slack)
  
  
The Senior Enterprise Systems Engineer (Teams & Slack) is a senior technical practitioner responsible for the engineering, administration, reliability, security, and continuous improvement of enterprise messaging and productivity platforms, with a primary focus on Microsoft Teams and Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Apps and Power Automate. The role will also support and engineer the firm’s enterprise Slack environment. This is a Hybrid role and works in 2pm-11pm IST shift.
  
  
**Key Job Responsibilities Include**
The engineer will serve as a subject matter expert for enterprise messaging, productivity, and low-code automation technologies, partnering with Digital Workplace engineering teams, Information Security, Identity & Access Management, business stakeholders, service delivery teams, and managed service partners to deliver secure, reliable, and intuitive digital workplace experiences for employees globally.
  
  

* Engineer, administer, and continuously improve enterprise Microsoft Teams, Power Platform, and Slack environments.
* Design and maintain platform configurations, policies, standards, governance controls, integrations, and lifecycle processes.
* Serve as an advanced engineering escalation point for complex messaging and productivity platform issues.
* Investigate escalations that require advanced platform engineering expertise and perform root-cause analysis to eliminate recurring problems.
* Engineer and maintain Microsoft Teams policies including messaging, meetings, applications, external access, guest access, federation, and related capabilities.
* Engineer and support Microsoft Power Platform capabilities, with a particular focus on Power Apps and Power Automate.
* Develop and maintain Power Apps and automated workflows where appropriate to improve employee productivity and simplify repeatable business and technology processes.
* Establish and maintain Power Platform environment strategies, governance standards, security controls, application lifecycle practices, and administrative processes.
* Support Power Platform connectors, integrations, APIs, gateways, and Dataverse capabilities where applicable.
* Engineer and administer enterprise Slack capabilities including workspaces, channels, applications, integrations, access controls, retention, and governance.
* Develop and maintain automation using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, REST APIs, Power Automate, or other appropriate technologies.
* Develop solutions that improve platform administration, reporting, provisioning, governance, lifecycle management, and operational efficiency.
* Monitor platform health, service performance, adoption indicators, capacity, configuration compliance, and other measures of platform reliability.
* Monitor Power Platform environments, applications, flows, capacity, connectors, and related platform health.
* Evaluate Microsoft 365, Teams, Power Platform, and Slack product changes and assess potential impact and opportunities for the enterprise environment.
* Plan, test, and implement new platform features and capabilities in a controlled, secure, and supportable manner.
* Partner with Information Security to implement security, data protection, retention, external access, application, connector, and compliance requirements.
* Partner with Identity & Access Management teams on authentication, SSO, provisioning, access controls, Conditional Access, and related identity capabilities.
* Establish and maintain appropriate Power Platform Data Loss Prevention policies and governance controls in partnership with Information Security.
* Support platform migrations, mergers and acquisitions, tenant consolidations, and other enterprise transformation activities as required.
* Partner with service desk, second-level support, and managed service providers to improve troubleshooting, knowledge, support procedures, and escalation quality.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation, engineering standards, operational procedures, runbooks, and knowledge articles.
* Participate in technical design reviews, change management, problem management, and major incident resolution when platform expertise is required.
* Identify opportunities to simplify the messaging and productivity environment, reduce technical debt, increase automation, and enhance employee experience.

Advanced Technical Escalation Responsibilities
  
  

* Investigate complex Teams, Power Platform, Slack, application, authentication, integration, workflow, and configuration issues.
* Identify patterns across escalated incidents and determine whether the underlying cause requires an engineering or platform-level correction.
* Perform root-cause analysis and implement permanent engineering solutions where possible.
* Work directly with affected stakeholders when advanced technical troubleshooting is necessary.
* Engage Microsoft, Slack, application vendors, or other technology providers when vendor-level escalation is required.
* Document resolutions and create knowledge that enables recurring issues to be resolved at the appropriate support level.
* Recommend platform, configuration, automation, governance, or process improvements based on trends identified through escalations.

**Required Experience & Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience supporting and engineering enterprise messaging, productivity, automation, or Microsoft 365 platforms, including advanced engineering experience.
* Strong hands-on experience administering and engineering Microsoft Teams in a medium-to-large enterprise environment.
* Strong understanding of Microsoft 365 architecture and the relationships among Teams, Power Platform, Entra ID, and other Microsoft 365 services.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Power Platform, particularly Power Apps and Power Automate.
* Experience designing, developing, supporting, or governing enterprise Power Apps and Power Automate solutions.
* Experience designing and implementing Teams policies, external access, guest access, federation, application controls, and governance.
* Experience with Power Platform environment management, connectors, security, application lifecycle management, and governance.
* Experience developing automation using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, REST APIs, Power Automate, or similar technologies.
* Strong understanding of enterprise identity, authentication, SSO, access management, and security concepts.
* Experience troubleshooting complex platform, authentication, application, integration, workflow, and configuration issues.
* Experience working with enterprise security, compliance, and data-governance requirements.
* Experience performing root-cause analysis and resolving complex technical problems.
* Experience working within enterprise Incident, Problem, and Change Management processes.
* Strong technical documentation and communication skills.
* Ability to independently investigate technical issues and work across multiple technical teams to drive resolution.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience administering, engineering, or governing Slack in an enterprise environment.
* Experience with Slack Enterprise Grid, enterprise applications, integrations, access controls, or platform governance.
* Microsoft 365, Teams, Power Platform, or related Microsoft certifications.
* Microsoft Power Platform certifications such as Power Platform Functional Consultant, Developer, or Solution Architect credentials.
* Slack administration or Slack Certified Administrator experience/certification.
* Experience with Microsoft Entra ID and Conditional Access.
* Experience with Dataverse, custom connectors, on-premises data gateways, or other Power Platform integration capabilities.
* Experience implementing Power Platform Center of Excellence capabilities or similar enterprise governance models.
* Experience implementing Power Platform Data Loss Prevention policies and enterprise governance controls.
* Experience with Microsoft Purview, retention, eDiscovery, information protection, or related compliance technologies.
* Experience supporting mergers, acquisitions, tenant-to-tenant migrations, or large-scale platform migrations.
* Experience with enterprise application integrations and API-based automation.
* Experience working within a global enterprise and with managed service providers.
* Familiarity with ITIL practices including Incident, Problem, Change, and Configuration Management.

When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You listen and deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem-solving key technical issues for our customers. As a Platform Customer Engineer (CE), you will partner with technical Sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to our customers. You will serve as the customer’s primary technical partner and trusted advisor, engaging in technical-led conversations to understand their business challenges. You will troubleshoot technical questions and roadblocks, engage in proofs-of-concepts and demos, and use your expertise to architect cross-pillar cloud solutions that solve these business challenges. You will have excellent technical, communication and organizational skills.
  
  
You will focus on identifying, pursuing, and winning new business workloads and driving engagement within existing ones. You will have a breadth of technical expertise, spanning infrastructure modernization, application modernization, data analytics and more. You will blend business expertise, market knowledge and direct technical engagement to prove the value of the Google Cloud portfolio.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

title: L2/L3 Backup Administrator Engineer - Location - Mumbai
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**L2/L3 Backup Administrator Engineer**

*Enterprise Backup • Commvault • DR/NDR • Data Protection*

**Position**

L2  Backup Administrator Engineer

**Experience**

5–10 Years

**Employment Type**

[Full-Time / Contract]

**Location**

Mumbai

**Primary Technology**

Commvault Backup & Recovery

**Preferred**

Veritas / Cloud Backup/Commvault

1. Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced L2/L3 Backup Administrator Engineer responsible for designing, implementing, administering, troubleshooting, and optimizing enterprise backup and recovery infrastructure. The role requires strong hands-on experience with Commvault, with additional knowledge of Veritas for migration activities.

The engineer will manage backup and recovery across virtual machines, physical servers, databases, Kubernetes, storage infrastructure, and enterprise applications, while supporting DR/NDR operations, backup migrations, restoration, capacity planning, security, compliance, and continuous improvement.

2. Key Responsibilities

Backup Solution Design & Implementation

**•**
Design, implement, configure, and manage enterprise backup solutions for critical systems, applications, and databases.

**•**
Understand application and infrastructure requirements and design appropriate backup policies and protection strategies.

**•**
Build new backup environments/solutions from scratch based on business and technical requirements.

**•**
Perform workload onboarding and migration to new backup platforms with minimum business disruption.

**•**
Configure backup policies, schedules, retention, storage pools, deduplication, compression, and auxiliary copy requirements.

**•**
Ensure backup solutions meet defined RPO, RTO, retention, and business continuity requirements.

Commvault Administration

**•**
Administer and troubleshoot Commvault Backup & Recovery environments, including CommCell, MediaAgents, storage pools, deduplication databases, libraries, policies, and schedules.

**•**
Manage backup, restore, auxiliary copy, retention, and storage operations.

**•**
Monitor backup health, failed/pending jobs, storage utilization, deduplication, and overall environment performance.

**•**
Troubleshoot Commvault configuration, infrastructure, connectivity, and performance issues.

**•**
Raise and manage OEM/vendor support cases and coordinate resolution through closure.

**•**
Implement applicable Commvault security and hardening capabilities.

Backup Monitoring & Operations

**•**
Monitor backup operations and ensure successful completion within agreed SLAs.

**•**
Review daily backup reports and identify failed, missed, pending, or abnormal jobs.

**•**
Perform root-cause analysis for recurring backup failures and implement permanent corrective actions.

**•**
Maintain daily/weekly/monthly backup operational reports and dashboards.

Backup Troubleshooting & Restoration

**•**
Handling incidents and complex backup-related technical issues.

**•**
Troubleshoot backup and restore failures across VMware/VMs, physical servers, Linux, Windows, Solaris, Oracle, MS SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Kubernetes, and enterprise applications.

**•**
Perform file-level, VM-level, database-level, and application-level restoration.

**•**
Validate restoration integrity and prepare RCA/corrective action plans for major incidents.

Disaster Recovery – DR/NDR

**•**
Develop and maintain backup and disaster recovery procedures.

**•**
Configure and maintain backup/replication copies at DR and NDR locations.

**•**
Enable backup protection for workloads migrated to DR and maintain required secondary copies.

**•**
Participate in DR drills, BCP exercises, and disaster recovery activities.

**•**
Validate restoration capability during DR drills and document observations and corrective actions.

Backup Migration

**•**
Plan and execute migration from legacy backup platforms to Commvault or other target platforms.

**•**
Support Veritas-to-Commvault workload migration.

**•**
Analyze existing policies, retention, storage consumption, and application dependencies before migration.

**•**
Validate successful backup and restoration after migration.

Capacity Planning & Optimization

**•**
Perform backup data sizing and capacity planning.

**•**
Monitor storage growth, deduplication ratios, compression, and retention consumption.

**•**
Optimize backup policies, storage utilization, backup windows, compression, deduplication, and auxiliary copy strategies.

Security & Compliance

**•**
Implement backup security and access controls as per organizational policies.

**•**
Support advanced Commvault security features and secure backup practices.

**•**
Support internal/external audits, including RBI and banking regulatory requirements where applicable.

**•**
Maintain audit evidence, backup reports, restoration records, policies, and governance documentation.

Documentation

**•**
Maintain up-to-date backup infrastructure and operational documentation.

**•**
Prepare Backup Architecture, Configuration, Policy Matrix, Backup/Restore SOPs, DR/NDR Configuration, Migration Plans, Health Check Reports, RCA documents, DR Drill documents, and Capacity Reports.

**•**
Update documentation after major configuration or infrastructure changes.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

**•**
Work with Application, Database, Server, Storage, Network, Security, and DR teams.

**•**
Understand application requirements and recommend suitable backup/recovery solutions.

**•**
Coordinate with OEMs and vendors for complex issues and technical escalations.

**•**
Participate in change management, implementation planning, and technical reviews.

Extended & Major Incident Support

**•**
Handle complex and critical backup incidents independently.

**•**
Provide L3 support for major backup failures, data recovery issues, and infrastructure incidents.

**•**
Provide support during DR drills, migrations, planned maintenance, and major implementation activities during weekends/night shifts when required.

**•**
Leave/comp-off will be managed as per agreed organizational/customer terms and applicable policy.

Continuous Improvement

**•**
Prepare and implement a quarterly backup process improvement plan.

**•**
Identify opportunities to improve reliability, performance, security, and operational efficiency.

**•**
Automate repetitive monitoring and operational activities where feasible.

**•**
Reduce recurring incidents through permanent corrective actions.

3. Mandatory Technical SkillsBackup Technologies

**•**
Strong hands-on experience with Commvault Backup & Recovery.

**•**
Enterprise backup administration, monitoring, troubleshooting, restore, retention, deduplication, compression, auxiliary copy, and capacity management.

Protected Workloads

**•**
VMware / Virtual Machines; Physical Servers; Linux; Windows; Solaris; Oracle; Microsoft SQL Server; PostgreSQL; MySQL; Kubernetes; Enterprise applications.

Storage & Infrastructure

**•**
Hands-on understanding of SAN, NAS, disk-based backup storage, backup repositories, storage capacity/performance, and deduplication storage.

**•**
Understanding of backup servers, MediaAgents, Fibre Channel, Ethernet networking, server hardware, and RAID concepts.

DR/NDR & Migration

**•**
Disaster Recovery concepts, secondary/replicated backup copies, DR/NDR architecture, DR drills, RPO/RTO, and restoration validation.

**•**
Experience migrating workloads from Veritas or other legacy platforms to Commvault.

4. Preferred Skills & CertificationsCertifications

**•**
Commvault certification.

**•**
Veritas Backup certification/experience.

**•**
Relevant cloud backup certification.

Additional Knowledge

**•**
Aws , GCP , Hitachi Vantara and Commvault backup technologies.

**•**
VMware and Kubernetes backup/recovery.

**•**
Backup security, ransomware protection, immutable backup, and air-gapped backup concepts.

**•**
Networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewall concepts, and required ports.

**•**
ITIL / ITSM processes and Incident, Problem, and Change Management.

5. QualificationsEducation

**•**
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

Experience

**•**
5–10 years of experience in enterprise Backup Administration.

**•**
3+ years of hands-on Commvault experience preferred.

**•**
Experience in L2/L3 support, implementation, troubleshooting, migration, and DR operations.

6. Key CompetenciesProfessional Competencies

**•**
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.

**•**
Ability to perform RCA for complex technical issues.

**•**
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

**•**
Ability to work independently at L2/L3 level.

**•**
Good documentation and reporting skills.

**•**
Ability to coordinate with multiple technical teams and vendors.

**•**
Ability to work under pressure during critical incidents and DR activities.

7. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)Performance Measures

**•**
Backup success rate and SLA adherence.

**•**
Backup failure resolution time.

**•**
Restoration success rate.

**•**
RPO/RTO and retention compliance.

**•**
DR/NDR backup availability and successful DR drills.

**•**
Backup storage and capacity optimization.

**•**
Reduction in recurring backup incidents.

**•**
Timely RCA and corrective action implementation.

**•**
Documentation and audit compliance.

**•**
Quarterly process improvement implementation.

8. Ideal Candidate ProfileProfile

**•**
The ideal candidate is a hands-on L2/L3 Backup Administrator with strong Commvault expertise, capable of independently managing enterprise backup infrastructure, troubleshooting complex backup/restore issues, supporting DR/NDR environments, performing Veritas-to-Commvault migration, handling database and Kubernetes backups, and driving continuous improvement.

**•**
Candidates with experience in large enterprise or banking environments, particularly those familiar with RBI/compliance requirements, DR drills, NDR, air-gapped/secure backup, and critical application recovery, will be preferred.

title: Security Operations Center Analyst
description:
**Job Title : SOC Analyst – L2**

**Experience : 3+ to 5+ Years of Experience in Security Operations**

**Location : Mumbai : BKC (Bandra Kurla Complex - Work from Office)**

**Job Summary :**

We are looking for an experienced and highly analytical
**SOC Analyst L2**
to join our Security Operations Center (SOC) / Cyber Defense Center (CDC). The SOC Analyst L2 will serve as an advanced incident responder responsible for investigating complex security incidents, conducting advanced threat hunting activities, developing detection use cases, and supporting security monitoring platforms such as
**IBM QRadar**
and
**SentinelOne EDR/XDR**
.

The candidate should possess deep expertise in incident investigation, malware analysis, threat intelligence, MITRE ATT&CK mapping, SIEM content development, and security operations processes. The role requires close collaboration with IT, Cloud, Engineering, and Security teams to enhance the organization's overall detection and response capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Security Monitoring & Incident Response**

* Perform in-depth investigation and analysis of security alerts escalated from L1 analysts.
* Lead the triage, containment, eradication, and recovery activities for cybersecurity incidents.
* Handle high-severity and critical incidents, including malware outbreaks, ransomware attacks, account compromises, insider threats, and advanced persistent threats (APTs).
* Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) and provide actionable remediation recommendations.
* Act as an escalation point for complex security investigations.

**Threat Hunting & Threat Intelligence**

* Conduct proactive threat hunting using endpoint, network, cloud, and identity telemetry.
* Leverage threat intelligence feeds, Indicators of Compromise (IOCs), Indicators of Attack (IOAs), and TTPs to identify emerging threats.
* Map attack techniques to the MITRE ATT&CK framework and identify gaps in detection coverage.
* Develop advanced hunting queries and investigative methodologies to uncover hidden threats.
* Monitor threat actor trends and emerging attack campaigns relevant to the organization's environment.

**Detection Engineering & Use Case Development**

* Design, develop, and optimize SIEM correlation rules and security analytics.
* Create and enhance custom dashboards, workbooks, reports, and visualizations.
* Perform alert tuning and reduce false positives while improving detection effectiveness.
* Develop security use cases aligned to threat intelligence and MITRE ATT&CK techniques.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to improve logging and visibility across enterprise environments.

**SIEM & EDR Administration**

* Manage and optimize IBM QRadar SIEM for monitoring, correlation, and investigations.
* Perform advanced investigations using SentinelOne EDR/XDR.
* Support onboarding and parsing new log sources.
* Develop custom integrations for unsupported data sources.
* Ensure data quality, normalization, and log source health across monitoring platforms.

**Malware, Phishing & Forensics Analysis**

* Analyze malware samples, suspicious files, and malicious URLs.
* Investigate phishing incidents utilizing email security tools and threat intelligence.
* Conduct endpoint investigations and digital forensic triage activities.
* Review attack chains and identify attacker techniques and persistence mechanisms.
* Document findings with detailed forensic timelines and recommendations.

**Incident Management & Process Improvement**

* Develop and maintain SOC playbooks, runbooks, and standard operating procedures.
* Participate in incident response tabletop exercises and simulation activities.
* Identify automation opportunities and support SOAR implementation initiatives.
* Review security incidents and recommend process improvements.
* Contribute to SOC maturity and continuous improvement programs.

**Collaboration & Mentorship**

* Mentor and guide L1 analysts during investigations and incident triage.
* Review and validate incident reports generated by junior team members.
* Collaborate with cloud, infrastructure, identity, and network teams for remediation activities.
* Provide technical expertise during internal and customer-facing security discussions.
* Participate in executive and customer incident briefings as required.

**Experience & Technical Skills**

* Minimum
  **3+ to 5+ years of experience in a SOC, Incident Response, Threat Detection, or Cyber Defense role.**
* Minimum
  **2+ years of hands-on experience with IBM QRadar SIEM.**
* Strong hands-on experience with
  **SentinelOne EDR/XDR**
  .
* Experience leading investigations of complex and critical security incidents.
* Proven experience in threat hunting and incident response activities.

**Security Operations**

* Advanced incident response and investigation skills.
* Threat detection and threat hunting expertise.
* Malware analysis and phishing investigation experience.
* Security monitoring and event correlation.
* Digital forensics and endpoint investigations.

**Frameworks & Methodologies**

* MITRE ATT&CK Framework.
* Cyber Kill Chain.
* NIST Incident Response Framework.
* Threat Intelligence Lifecycle.
* Security Operations Best Practices.

**SIEM & EDR**

* IBM QRadar administration and content management.
* Correlation rule creation and optimization.
* Dashboard and report development.
* SentinelOne EDR/XDR investigation capabilities.
* Alert tuning and use-case engineering.

**Networking & Security Fundamentals**

* TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, HTTPS, SMTP.
* IDS/IPS, Firewalls, Proxy Technologies.
* Network traffic analysis.
* Active Directory and Identity Management.
* Cloud security monitoring.

**Scripting & Automation**

* Security Automation and SOAR platforms

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in Managed Security Services (MSSP) environments.
* Experience with threat intelligence platforms.
* Experience building custom parsers, DSMs, and integrations.
* Experience with vulnerability management and attack surface monitoring.
* Experience working in customer-facing consulting engagements.
* Knowledge of Zero Trust Architecture.
* Experience performing purple team, threat emulation, or adversary simulation exercises.

**Preferred Certifications**

The following certifications are highly desirable:

**Industry Certifications**

* CompTIA CySA+
* CompTIA Security+
* EC-Council Certified SOC Analyst (CSA)
* EC-Council Certified Incident Handler (ECIH)
* GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH)
* GIAC Certified Intrusion Analyst (GCIA)
* Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH)
* CISSP (Associate or Certified)
* IBM QRadar SIEM Certifications
* SentinelOne Certifications
* Splunk Enterprise Security Certifications

A successful L2 SOC Analyst will:

* Independently investigate and resolve complex security incidents.
* Identify advanced threats through proactive threat hunting.
* Develop high-quality detection content and SIEM use cases.
* Reduce alert fatigue through effective tuning and optimization.
* Improve overall security visibility and detection coverage.
* Mentor junior analysts and contribute to SOC operational maturity.
* Drive continuous improvements in security monitoring, incident response, and threat intelligence integration.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a hands-on System Administrator to manage day-to-day IT infrastructure operations and end-user support. This role covers server administration support, CCTV/surveillance systems, desktop/laptop support, end-user application support, and printer/hardware troubleshooting. **Server & Infrastructure Support**

* Assist in day-to-day administration and monitoring of Windows/Linux servers
* Support routine server maintenance tasks: patching, backups, user account management (under guidance of Senior SA)
* Monitor server health and escalate issues to senior team members as needed
* Maintain basic Active Directory tasks — user creation, password resets, group management

**CCTV & Surveillance Administration**

* Install, configure, and maintain CCTV cameras, DVR/NVR systems, and surveillance software
* Monitor camera uptime, storage capacity, and recording quality
* Troubleshoot CCTV connectivity, storage, and playback issues
* Coordinate with vendors for CCTV hardware repairs/replacements
* Manage access to surveillance footage as per company policy

**Desktop/Laptop Support**

* Provide first-level and second-level support for desktops, laptops, and peripherals
* Install, configure, and troubleshoot operating systems (Windows) and standard software
* Manage IT asset inventory — laptops, desktops, monitors, accessories
* Handle new employee IT onboarding (system setup) and offboarding (data wipe, asset recovery)
* Perform OS imaging, software installation, and system upgrades

**End-User Application Support**

* Provide support for standard business applications (MS Office, email/Outlook, VPN clients, ERP/SAP end-user issues, etc.)
* Troubleshoot login issues, application errors, and connectivity problems for end users
* Coordinate with application/software vendors for issue resolution
* Maintain and update user access for common business applications

**Printer & Hardware Support**

* Install, configure, and maintain printers, scanners, and other office hardware
* Troubleshoot printer connectivity, driver, and hardware issues
* Manage printer consumables (toner/cartridge) tracking and vendor coordination
* Maintain AMC (Annual Maintenance Contract) records and coordinate vendor visits for hardware repairs

**Network & General IT Support**

* Support basic network troubleshooting (LAN connectivity, Wi-Fi, patch cords, switch ports)
* Assist in maintaining network cabling, patch panels, and rack organization
* Support video conferencing/meeting room IT equipment setup

**Documentation & Ticketing**

* Log, track, and resolve IT support tickets within defined SLAs
* Maintain accurate documentation of IT assets, configurations, and recurring issues
* Prepare and update SOPs for common support tasks

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 2–5 years of experience in system administration / IT support / desktop support roles
* Working knowledge of Windows Server basics and Windows OS (10/11) troubleshooting
* Hands-on experience with CCTV systems (installation, configuration, troubleshooting)
* Good understanding of desktop/laptop hardware, printers, and peripheral troubleshooting
* Basic networking knowledge (LAN, Wi-Fi, IP configuration)
* Experience supporting end-user applications (MS Office, Outlook, basic ERP/SAP GUI issues)
* Ticketing tool experience (ServiceNow, Freshservice, or similar) preferred

**Preferred Certifications**

* CompTIA A+ / Network+
* Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Fundamentals / MD-100 (Windows Client)
* Any CCTV/surveillance vendor certification (Hikvision, CP Plus, Dahua, etc.) is a plus

**Soft Skills**

* Good communication and customer-service orientation (this is a user-facing role)
* Ability to prioritize and handle multiple support requests
* Willingness to do hands-on/physical work (hardware, cabling, on-site visits)
* Team player, comfortable working under the Senior SA's guidance

* Provide first-line technical support for Duck Creek applications, responding to user inquiries and resolving incidents.
* Investigate and troubleshoot application issues, working to identify root causes and implement resolutions.
* Support day-to-day ticket operations, reduce backlog, and improve service delivery
* Escalate complex issues specialized departments when necessary.
* Document incidents, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions for future reference in support knowledge bases.
* Work with internal teams to identify recurring issues and recommend long-term solutions to improve system performance.
* Collaborate with application development and infrastructure teams to resolve issues and implement new features.
* Maintain response time, communication standards, and a professional approach to customer resolution
* Participate in training sessions and stay up to date on system updates, application changes, and new functionalities. Perform all other duties and activities as required.
* Act in accordance with and as a good steward of Duck Creek Technologies mission, vision, and core values:
* Mission: To empower insurers to reimagine the future of insurance
* Vision: To transform insurance technology, helping insurers be smarter, faster, and more efficient, and ultimately provide the best protection for people and businesses
* Values: We Prioritize Respect, We Listen, We Care, We Add Value, and We Lead

**What You’ve Done**
Education and Work Experience:
  
  
Bullet list describing the education & experience to perform the role, including any certifications.
  
  
**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 2-5 years of experience in application support, IT operations, or a similar technical support role.

**Preferred**

* Experience with Duck Creek Technologies products or similar enterprise software.
* Knowledge of IT service management frameworks such as ITIL.
* Experience in the insurance technology sector or related industries.

**Skills, Knowledge, Abilities, And Behaviors**

* Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with an ability to resolve basic application issues.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills to effectively document incidents and collaborate with team members.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
* Understanding of IT environments, including basic networking, infrastructure, and cloud technologies.
* Ability to escalate complex issues and collaborate with senior staff to resolve them.
* Familiarity with enterprise software release cycles and deployment processes.
* Knowledge of incident, problem, and change management processes.
* Customer-oriented mindset, focused on providing prompt and effective technical support.
* Strong organizational skills, with attention to detail in managing incident logs and troubleshooting steps.
* Ability to adapt to changing technologies and stay updated on new features and system enhancements.
* Basic knowledge of Agile and DevOps methodologies as they relate to application support.
* Ability to work independently and in a team, supporting larger initiatives and projects as needed.
* Analytical skills to evaluate performance trends and suggest improvements in application support processes.
* Strong commitment to continuous learning and development in application support best practices.

**Technical Competencies**

* SQL Server: Ability to perform basic queries (CRUD), understand database schemas and relationships between tables, and create or update stored procedures, functions, views, SQL Server Agent jobs, maintenance plans, and other SQL Server resources. Intermediate or above understanding of advanced SQL topics, including T-SQL, cursors, CTEs, temporary tables, joins, subqueries, transactions and error handling, indexing, query execution plans and performance analysis, XML querying, basic dynamic SQL, backups and restoration, and SQL tracing/profiling. Strong working knowledge of SQL Server Replication, including configuration and creation of replication, monitoring replication health, and troubleshooting/debugging replication failures, synchronization issues, and related data problems.
* Azure: Working knowledge of the Azure Portal and core services used to support applications, including Azure App Services, Azure Storage, Azure SQL, Azure Functions, Azure Data Factory, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure Active Directory/AAD) including identity and access management, and Azure Key Vault. Ability to review configuration and logs, debug and troubleshoot application issues, connect to and query Azure SQL databases, perform basic tracing, monitor and troubleshoot Data Factory pipelines, and investigate authentication, access, and secret/configuration-related issues.
* Debugging and Troubleshooting: Ability to systematically investigate and isolate application, data, integration, and configuration issues using logs, error messages, stack traces, database queries, trace files, and other diagnostic information. Able to reproduce issues, identify root causes, distinguish application defects from configuration or data problems, and clearly document findings for escalation when required.
* IIS: Working knowledge of Internet Information Services (IIS), including websites, application pools, authentication, application configuration, log files, and a basic understanding of bindings. Ability to restart applications/application pools, review IIS and application logs, troubleshoot availability and connectivity issues, and diagnose common application pool, authentication, and configuration-related problems.
* SSO / SAML: Working knowledge of Single Sign-On (SSO) and SAML-based authentication, including identity provider and service provider concepts, SAML assertions, metadata, certificates, claims/attributes, and authentication flows. Ability to troubleshoot common SSO issues involving configuration, user access, claims, redirects, and failed authentication.
* API: Working knowledge of REST APIs and web services, including HTTP methods, endpoints, request/response formats, headers, authentication, status codes, and JSON/XML payloads. Ability to test and troubleshoot API calls using tools such as Postman and Swagger/OpenAPI, review API documentation and request/response data, and diagnose common authentication, connectivity, configuration, and data-related issues.
* Other Technical Skills: Working knowledge of FTP/SFTP, XML/XSLT, and PowerShell. Ability to read, modify, and troubleshoot XML and XSLT; use PowerShell for basic scripting, automation, and troubleshooting; configure, test, and troubleshoot FTP/SFTP-based file transfers; and read and understand application code for troubleshooting purposes, including .NET, JET, HTML, JavaScript, and other relevant languages or technologies.

CORE COMPETENCIES
  
  
Our team is built on strong core values that guide how we work and grow together. We prioritize clear and thoughtful communication, fostering open collaboration across diverse perspectives to achieve shared goals. We approach challenges with curiosity and critical thinking, seeking creative solutions while remaining adaptable in a fast-changing environment. We take accountability for our work and outcomes, holding ourselves to high standards of integrity and professionalism. Above all, we are committed to doing the right thing—treating others with respect, embracing continuous learning, and engaging inclusively across cultures and backgrounds.
  
  
LEARN MORE

This role is aligned to a specific location, and you are expected to reside within reasonable proximity to that location. You will partner with your leader to participate in meaningful in-person moments that support team connection, collaboration, and business priorities.
  
  
At the start of your employment, your work may be performed remotely, subject to business needs and company guidelines. As our Flying Together approach continues to evolve, you may be expected to transition to a hybrid work arrangement, including working from a designated office location on a schedule determined by your leader and organizational needs.
  
  
The Company reserves the right to modify your work arrangement, including location expectations and in-person requirements, based on business needs, organizational policy, or regulatory considerations.
  
  
**What We Stand For**
Our global team values the unique perspectives each employee brings. Our success is driven by an inclusive culture where everyone can learn from one another, regardless of role or background. This collaborative approach helps us continuously improve our products, services, and systems.

We strive to lead by example in inclusion, diversity, and equity, creating an environment where employees can be their authentic selves. Our values guide us: We Prioritize Respect, We Listen, We Care, We Add Value, and We Lead.

title: CloudOps Engineer (L2)
description:
**Job Purpose**
The Frontline Infrastructure Support Engineer (L2) is responsible for providing advanced technical support, incident resolution, and operational management across enterprise IT infrastructure. The role involves diagnosing and resolving complex infrastructure issues, performing administration activities, implementing changes, supporting problem management, and mentoring L1 engineers while ensuring high service availability and SLA compliance.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**
**Infrastructure Administration & Operations**

* Administer and maintain Windows, Linux, virtualization, Kubernetes, storage, backup and GPU infrastructure to ensure high availability and operational stability.
* Perform proactive health checks, capacity monitoring, performance tuning, and preventive maintenance activities.

**Advanced Incident Management**

* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve Level 2 infrastructure incidents within defined SLAs.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring incidents and coordinate with L3 teams for permanent resolution.
* Review escalations from L1 teams and provide technical guidance during incident resolution.
* Participate in Major Incident Management and support service restoration activities.

**Windows Server & Active Directory Administration**

* Administer Windows Server environments, including Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, File Services, and Windows services.
* Manage user accounts, organizational units, security groups, permissions, and authentication-related activities.
* Troubleshoot server performance, replication, authentication, and domain-related issues.

**Linux Administration**

* Perform Linux server administration, including user management, package management, service configuration, performance tuning, and security patching.
* Analyze system logs, troubleshoot kernel and OS issues, and optimize server performance.

**Virtualization Administration**

* Administer Cloud native/VMware/Hyper-V environments, including VM provisioning, snapshots, cloning, migration, and resource optimization.
* Monitor hypervisor performance and troubleshoot virtualization platform issues.

**Kubernetes Administration**

* Administer Kubernetes clusters, including node management, workload deployment, pod lifecycle management, namespace administration, and cluster health monitoring.
* Troubleshoot cluster failures, resource constraints, networking, and orchestration issues.

**Storage & Backup Administration**

* Administer enterprise storage systems, LUN provisioning, storage allocation, capacity management, and performance optimization.
* Manage enterprise backup solutions, perform backup validation, restore operations, and troubleshoot backup failures.

**GPU Infrastructure Administration**

* Administer GPU-based infrastructure supporting AI/ML workloads.
* Monitor GPU utilization, troubleshoot hardware/software issues, perform firmware validation, and coordinate hardware replacement activities.

**Hardware & Data Center Support**

* Diagnose server hardware failures involving CPU, memory, storage, RAID, power supplies, and network interfaces.
* Coordinate hardware replacements with vendors and perform post-maintenance validation.

**Change & Problem Management**

* Execute approved infrastructure changes following organizational change management processes.
* Participate in Problem Management by identifying recurring issues and implementing preventive actions.

**Documentation & Continuous Improvement**

* Develop and maintain technical documentation, SOPs, runbooks, and knowledge articles.
* Mentor L1 engineers and contribute to operational excellence and automation initiatives.
* Support audit, compliance, and governance activities.

**Experience & Educational Requirement**
BE/B-Tech or equivalent with Computer Science or Electronics & Communication
  
  
**Relevant Experience**

* 4–6 years of hands-on experience in Windows/Linux Administration, Active Directory, VMware/Hyper-V, Kubernetes, Storage & Backup Administration, Network Operations, GPU Infrastructure Administration, Troubleshooting, Incident, Problem Management and Infrastructure Troubleshooting.
* Experience supporting mission – critical production environments with 24 x 7 operations
* 4–6 years of experience in Hardware Support, Change Management, Documentation, ITIL Processes, Vendor Coordination, Automation (PowerShell/Bash/Python), Operational Reporting, and Team Collaboration.
* Preferred Exposure: Experience working with cloud platforms including Microsoft Azure, AWS or Google Cloud Platform, cloud native virtualization platforms, VMware, Nutanix, Kubernetes/Openshift environments, cloud native storage, Enterprise storage like NetApp & HPE etc. Backup Solution like Commvault & Cloud native backup tools, enterprise monitoring tools such as Zabbix, Zoho etc. & ITSM Platform including Manage Engine & Service Now etc. and GPU infrastructure supporting AI/ML workload is preferred

title: Technical Customer Support Professional
description:
**Empower Structural Innovation as a Technical Support Professional – Tekla Structures (Concrete, Precast, & Rebar)**
Are you a customer-focused structural professional who loves deconstructing complex software challenges? Trimble is seeking a high-caliber Technical Support Professional to join our dedicated Customer Support network. In this high-impact position, you will serve as the premier point of contact for enterprise clients navigating advanced workflows within
**Tekla Structures**
, specifically focusing on the Concrete, Precast, and Rebar modules. Your immediate technical expertise will ensure engineering and detailing teams around the world minimize downtime and achieve structural precision.
  
  
**About Us**
Dedicated to the world’s tomorrow, Trimble is a technology company delivering solutions that enable our customers to work in new ways to measure, build, grow and move goods for a better quality of life. Core technologies in positioning, modeling, connectivity and data analytics connect the digital and physical worlds to improve productivity, quality, safety, transparency and sustainability. From purpose-built products and enterprise lifecycle solutions to industry cloud services, Trimble is transforming critical industries such as construction, geospatial, agriculture and transportation to power an interconnected world of work. For more information about Trimble (NASDAQ: TRMB), visit: www.trimble.com
  
  
**Our Product Ecosystem:**
Tekla software solutions are the global standard for advanced Building Information Modeling (BIM) and structural engineering. From massive cast-in-place concrete structures to complex precast components and high-density reinforcement detailing, Tekla drives structural lifecycle efficiency from design to the job site.
  
  
**What Makes This Role Great**
In this role, you will transition from a day-to-day detailer or modeller into a highly valued structural subject matter expert. Operating within our state-of-the-art hubs in Chennai or Navi Mumbai, you will have the technical autonomy to reverse-engineer software anomalies, troubleshoot localized configurations, and configure cross-platform cloud integrations. You will work closely with global helpdesks and act as a crucial voice-of-the-customer, directly collaborating with Trimble’s Product Development teams to advocate for product updates and eliminate architectural bottlenecks.
  
  
Key Exciting Responsibilities
  
  

* Complex Modeling Resolution: Provide clear, step-by-step technical guidance to resolve advanced structural modeling and parametric geometry issues faced by global engineering accounts.
* Database & Catalog Orchestration: Manage, audit, and troubleshoot intricate software databases, custom reinforcement catalogs, and automated Bar Bending Schedules (BBS).
* Deliverable Configuration Support: Assist detailers in configuring and optimizing General Arrangement (GA) drawings, Cast Unit drawings, automated rebar schedules, and custom Template Editor (.tpl) reports.
* Environment Architecture Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve localized company environment bugs, including custom parametric components, complex drawing layouts, custom attributes, and enterprise firm/project folder paths.
* Cloud & Interoperability Engineering: Support collaborative cloud workspaces by resolving interoperability bottlenecks across Trimble Connect, Tekla Model Sharing, and open BIM data exchanges (IFC, DWG, DXF, BVBS).
* Bug Replication & Product Escalation: Systematically replicate user-reported software errors, document system limitations, and escalate unresolved code defects to global development teams while populating internal knowledge bases.

**Essential Skills & Experience**

* Professional Experience: 4+ years of direct, hands-on experience utilizing or supporting Tekla Structures. Highly preferred experience operating within an RCC, Precast detailing, or high-fidelity BIM production environment.
* Technical Deep-Dive Mastery: Complete mastery of Tekla Structures software functionality, system configurations, directory folders, detailing standards, and reinforcement modules.
* Diagnostic Capabilities: Strong analytical and diagnostic skills with a proven capability to investigate system logs, reverse-engineer software errors, and troubleshoot severe system crashes under pressure.
* Communication & Deadline Focus: Exceptional, patient, and highly professional written and verbal communication skills to deliver technical solutions clearly to users working under strict engineering deadlines.
* Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering.

**Bonus Points For**

* Workflow Automation Tooling: Practical knowledge or script exposure to Tekla Open API, C#, or Grasshopper for parametric workflow automation.
* Advanced Component Customization: Direct experience developing complex parametric Custom Components and custom software macros.
* Cross-Domain Competency: Prior structural background or foundational workflow knowledge in structural steel detailing and fabrication logic.

**Logistics**

* Locations: Chennai or Navi Mumbai, India
* Department: Customer Support / Technical Services
* Job Type: Full-Time

Why You'll Love Working With Us
  
  
At Trimble, we're not just a company that "does good"—we are a team dedicated to making a tangible, positive Real-World Impact. We build innovative solutions designed to solve the world's most critical challenges. From construction sites to transportation hubs, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow.
  
  

* You'll work on projects that truly matter: Our purpose-driven culture means you'll be helping to build and deliver solutions that make work faster, safer, and more sustainable for millions of people worldwide.
* Collaborate with like-minded people: Our strong internal culture is a "hidden gem." You will work with a collaborative, supportive team that shares your purpose and fosters a genuine sense of belonging.
* Be an owner: Trimble thrives on individuals who take initiative and embrace ownership. You'll find an entrepreneurial spirit where success is often "self-authored," empowering proactive "doers."
* Enjoy true flexibility: We offer flexible work arrangements, which are a significant driver for employees joining and staying with us.

****How to Apply:****
Please submit an online application for this position by clicking on the ‘Apply Now’ button located in this posting.
  
  
**Join a Values-Driven Team: Belong, Grow, Innovate.**
At Trimble, our core values of Belong, Grow, and Innovate aren't just words—they're the foundation of our culture. We foster an environment where you are seen, heard, and valued (Belong); where you have an opportunity to build a career and drive our collective growth (Grow); and where your innovative ideas shape the future (Innovate). We believe in empowering local teams to create impactful strategies, ensuring our global vision resonates with every individual. Become part of a team where your contributions truly matter.

title: Citrix Engineer L2/L3
description:
Hello All,

We have an opening for a
**Citrix Engineer**
at
**Turbhe, Navi Mumbai**
.

Job Description – Citrix Engineer

**Implementation, Migration & Operations**

**Experience:**
4–8 Years

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Function:**
Infrastructure / End User Computing / Managed Services

**Position Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Citrix Engineer responsible for the implementation, administration, optimization, troubleshooting, and day-to-day operations of Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops environments.

The candidate will work across implementation projects, migrations, upgrades, L2/L3 operations, incident management, performance optimization, and customer support. The role requires strong hands-on expertise in Citrix technologies along with a good understanding of Microsoft Windows, Active Directory, networking, virtualization, and security.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Citrix Implementation & Deployment:**
Design, install, configure, and implement Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (CVAD) / DAAS environments; configure Delivery Controllers, StoreFront, Studio, Director, Licensing, and VDAs; deploy Citrix Gateway / NetScaler ADC; configure Machine Catalogs, Delivery Groups, applications, desktops, and policies; integrate with Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, GPO, and authentication services.

**Citrix Migration & Upgrade:**
Perform Citrix version upgrades, migrations, and environment modernization; execute migrations with minimal downtime; migrate workloads between farms, sites, hypervisors, or infrastructure platforms; support migration to Citrix Cloud; perform health checks and post-migration validation.

**Operations & Administration:**
Manage production Citrix environments; monitor availability, capacity, and performance; troubleshoot login, application launch, session, VDA, profile, printing, and connectivity issues; manage policies, applications, desktops, sessions, and access permissions; perform preventive maintenance and 24x7 rotational support where required.

**Citrix ADC / NetScaler:**
Configure and troubleshoot Gateway virtual servers, authentication, certificates, SSL/TLS, session policies, and load balancing; perform firmware upgrades and configuration backup/restore.

**User Profile & Endpoint Technologies:**
Troubleshoot FSLogix, Citrix Profile Management, folder redirection, Windows multi-session/single-session environments, thin clients, endpoint connectivity, printers, scanners, USB redirection, and Citrix Workspace App.

**Virtualization & Infrastructure:**
Support Citrix environments hosted on VMware vSphere/ESXi, Microsoft Hyper-V, or Nutanix AHV; understand VM sizing, CPU, memory, storage, networking, and capacity planning.

**Incident, Problem & Change Management:**
Handle L2/L3 incidents and service requests; perform RCA; participate in problem management; implement changes following ITIL processes; support major incidents and customer escalations.

**Monitoring, Performance & Optimization:**

2.Develope certificate enrollment APIs and contributed to development activities within the JioCA in-house open-source PKI stack.

3.Implemente automation using REST APIs for certificate enrollment, renewal, and lifecycle management.

4.Designe and configured workflow automation for certificate approval processes for Telco teams and other stakeholders.

5.Implement Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and integrated PKI services with enterprise Identity and Access Management (IAM) systems.

6.Implement UI customizations and portal enhancements to improve usability and operational efficiency.

7.Integrate application and device certificate provisioning across internal platforms and services.

8.Establishe CI/CD pipelines for endpoint applications, integrating certificate-based security into the software delivery lifecycle.

9.Implement code-signing certificate workflows for Windows, macOS, Linux, IoT, and edge devices.

10. Enable PKI automation and API integrations with internal systems and applications.

• Subject matter expert of digital certificate technology that includes all tiers in Certificate Authority (CA) hierarchy.

• Identify and document PKI requirements for all infrastructure devices and software within the company.

• Create and maintain documentation on certificate installation guidelines.

• The first point of contact in response to the renewal of digital certificates before expirations.

• Execute fulfilment requests to purchase or renew certificates.

• Coordinate certification installations and revoke unused certificates with other technical teams to ensure no outage to devices and software.

• Collaborate with the vendor and other technical teams as required to reach resolutions on any issues related to digital certificates.

• Automate monitoring and alerting of the validity of all digital certificates at infrastructure and applications layers.

**Description**
**About the Role:**
The Service Desk Analyst is the first point of contact for all global IT and service requests, resolving issues by phone, email, ticket and in person, and escalating what can't be fixed at first line. You should deliver excellent, timely support to users across multiple business areas, so that issues are resolved with minimal business impact and within SLA.
  
  
The Global Service Desk Team has 5 analysts. It supports 1500+ users worldwide, 24 hours a day, 5 days a week (moving to 24x7), on a follow-the-sun shift pattern.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Ticket and incident management**

* Act as first-level contact for users and resolve issues, or convey resolutions, by phone, email, service desk tickets and face to face.
* Maintain control of the Global Service Desk queue: log, prioritise, resolve and reassign tickets as soon as possible after they are raised.
* Take ownership of tickets and see them through to prompt, satisfactory resolution, collaborating with the team as needed.
* Prioritise business-affecting issues and escalate unresolved queries to the right level of support so problems are fixed within SLA.
* Track, route and redirect problems to the correct resources.
* Follow the Global Incident Management guidelines and ensure proper recording, documentation and closure of every ticket.

**User support and onboarding/off boarding**

* Walk users through the problem-solving process, follow up and provide feedback until the issue is resolved.
* Manage user on- and off-boarding in line with the agreed process flow and timescales, including updating user data.
* Set up new equipment globally, handing over to regional support where required.
* Install and configure software on user machines.
* Support multiple business areas, including IT, Application Support, Facilities and Travel.

**Service quality and relationships**

* Deliver efficient customer service that meets and exceeds user expectations.
* Build strong relationships across all business areas and represent the Service Desk positively to internal customers, clients and suppliers.
* Take part in the 24x5 global shift Rota (moving to 24x7) so users in every region are supported during their working hours.
* Produce activity reports and attend regular 1:1s with the department head to cascade priorities.
* Recommend procedure changes and improvements, and keep growing your knowledge of help desk procedures, products and services.

* Windows 10/11 and macOS (OS X) support

description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**
As a Security Managed Services Engineer (L1) at NTT DATA, you will step into an entry-level role focused on maintaining our clients' firewall infrastructures. Your main objective will be to ensure our Service Level Agreements (SLAs) are met with zero missed conditions. You'll be front-line support, handling standard and low-complexity incidents and service requests, as well as contributing to project work when needed.
  
  
Daily, you'll monitor client infrastructure and solutions, quickly identifying and investigating problems and errors before or as they occur. You'll provide telephonic, ITSM ticket or chat support to clients, ensuring efficient and comprehensive resolutions of incidents and requests. By scheduling maintenance activities like patching and configuration changes, you contribute to a proactive approach in managing and optimizing workflows.
  
  
You'll follow necessary handover procedures for shift changes to ensure service continuity and update existing knowledge articles—or create new ones. A key part of your role will be identifying opportunities for work optimization, including automation of work, request fulfilment, incident resolution, and other process improvements. You may also be involved in implementing and delivering disaster recovery functions and tests.
  
  
**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**

* Entry-level experience with troubleshooting and providing support in security, network, DATA centre, systems, or storage administration and monitoring services within a medium to large ICT organization.
* Working knowledge of ITIL processes.
* Skills in active listening techniques such as paraphrasing, probing for further relevant information, and refraining from interrupting.
* Highly disciplined in handling of tickets on day-to-day basis. Act promptly as per defined Sop’s.
* Try to resolve as many tickets as possible using available Knowledge articles or provided Sop’s.
* Good understanding of using ITSM tools.
* Ability to communicate and work across different cultures and social groups.
* Capacity to plan activities and projects well in advance, adapting to changing circumstances as needed.
* Positive outlook and ability to perform well under pressure.
* Eagerness to work diligently and extend hours when necessary.
* Client-centric approach, always putting clients at the forefront of interactions.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in IT/Computing or demonstrated equivalent work experience.

On-site Working

confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more
  
  
than 70 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as

 Job Description \- Technical Support Engineer (Linux / Windows / GitLab / Networking)
   

  

 Job Title
   

  

 Technical Support Engineer
   

  

**Experience**
 1\-3 Years
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are looking for a proactive and technically skilled Technical Support Engineer with 2\-3 years of experience in Linux, Windows Server administration, GitLab, and networking. The ideal candidate should possess strong troubleshooting skills and be capable of supporting server infrastructure, network devices, and DevOps tools while ensuring high system availability.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Provide L2 technical support for Linux and Windows servers.
   

  

 Install, configure, and troubleshoot Linux (Ubuntu/RHEL/CentOS) and Windows Server environments.

 Maintain technical documentation, SOPs, and incident reports.
   

  

 Participate in on\-call support and production issue handling when required.

 Version Control
   

  

 Git

 tcpdump
   

  

 netstat
   

  

 traceroute
   

  

 ping
   

  

 Wireshark

 Zabbix
   

  

 Grafana
   

  

 Prometheus

 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.

 Basic understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) is desirable.
   

  

 Experience with HAProxy, Nginx, Apache, or Keepalived is a plus.
   

  

 Soft Skills
   

  

 Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
   

  

 Excellent communication skills.
   

  

 Ability to work independently and within a team.

title: Senior IT Administrator
description:
**The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of Finance**
 At CoinDCX, our mission is clear—to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance.
   

  

 As India’s first crypto unicorn valued at $2\.45B, we are reshaping the financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that power adoption at scale.
   

  

 We believe that change starts together. It begins with bold ideas, relentless execution, and people who want to build what’s next.
   

  

 If you’re driven by purpose and thrive in environments where your work defines the next chapter of an industry, you’ll feel right at home here.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As an IT System Administrator / Senior System Administrator , you'll be the backbone of CoinDCX's internal technology ecosystem, ensuring our employees have a secure, reliable, and seamless IT experience every day.
   

  

 This role goes beyond resolving technical issues—you'll help build scalable IT operations, strengthen endpoint security, streamline identity and access management, and continuously improve how technology enables our teams. If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges while creating long\-term operational excellence, this role offers an opportunity to make a meaningful impact in one of India's fastest\-growing fintech organizations.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own end\-to\-end endpoint support by troubleshooting hardware, software, operating system, and network\-related issues across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android devices.
* Deliver exceptional L1 IT support by resolving user issues efficiently while ensuring an outstanding employee experience.
* Manage employee onboarding and offboarding by provisioning devices, accounts, application access, and ensuring secure deprovisioning.
* Administer Identity \& Access Management (IAM), MDM platforms, and SaaS applications to maintain secure and compliant user access.
* Drive incident, change, and asset management processes while maintaining accurate documentation, SOPs, and ticketing records.
* Monitor system health, analyze recurring issues, and implement permanent solutions that improve IT reliability and operational efficiency.
* Collaborate with internal teams and L2/L3 support to resolve complex technical issues while ensuring timely communication with stakeholders.
* Support network infrastructure, wireless access points, antivirus solutions, and endpoint security initiatives to maintain a secure workplace.


**You'll Excel in This Role If You**
* Think proactively and focus on preventing issues rather than simply resolving them.
* Have a strong ownership mindset and consistently deliver reliable IT support.
* Enjoy troubleshooting complex technical problems across endpoints, operating systems, and networks.
* Communicate clearly with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Are process\-oriented with strong documentation and organizational skills.
* Thrive in fast\-paced environments where priorities evolve quickly.
* Continuously learn new technologies and look for opportunities to automate and improve IT operations.


**What We're Looking For**
* 4 years of experience in IT Infrastructure, IT Support, System Administration, or FinTech IT Operations.
* Strong expertise in Windows, macOS, hardware diagnostics, software troubleshooting, and endpoint management.
* Experience with Employee Onboarding \& Offboarding processes.
* Hands\-on knowledge of Identity \& Access Management (IAM).
* Experience managing Mobile Device Management (MDM) platforms across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android.
* Familiarity with SaaS administration including Active Directory, Microsoft Teams, Slack, and related collaboration tools.
* Working knowledge of ticketing platforms such as Jira, ServiceNow, or ManageEngine ServiceDesk.
* Understanding of networking fundamentals including LAN, VLAN, IP addressing, OSI model, and wireless access points.
* Knowledge of antivirus solutions, endpoint security, and IT compliance best practices.
* Experience with Incident Management, Change Management, and IT Asset Management.
* IT certifications such as ITIL, MCSA, or MCP will be an added advantage.
* Willingness to travel or relocate based on business requirements.


**You'll Know You're Winning When**
 Within your first six months:
   

  

* Employees experience fast, reliable, and high\-quality IT support with improved resolution times.
* Onboarding and offboarding processes are standardized, secure, and executed with zero operational gaps.
* Endpoint compliance, device management, and identity access processes are consistently maintained.
* Documentation, SOPs, and IT operational processes become more structured and scalable.
* Repeat incidents are reduced through proactive problem management and permanent fixes.
* Internal stakeholders trust the IT team as a reliable business partner.


**Why This Role Matters \& What's In It For You**
 Technology is the foundation that enables every CoinDCX team to innovate at speed. In this role, you'll directly influence the productivity, security, and operational excellence of the organization.
   

  

 You'll work with modern IT infrastructure, SaaS ecosystems, security tools, and enterprise technologies while gaining exposure to one of India's leading Web3 and fintech companies. As CoinDCX continues to scale, you'll have opportunities to grow your technical expertise, contribute to automation initiatives, and build systems that support the future of finance.
   

  

**Hiring Process**
 Here's what your journey with us looks like:
   

  

* Application Review – We assess your skills, experience, and alignment with the role.
* Recruiter Connect – A conversation to understand your background and career aspirations.
* Technical Interview(s) – Deep dive into your IT infrastructure knowledge, troubleshooting approach, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Practical Assessment / Scenario Discussion – Evaluate your ability to diagnose, prioritize, and resolve real\-world IT challenges.
* Culture \& Values Discussion – Understand how you collaborate, communicate, and thrive in fast\-paced environments.
* Leadership Conversation (Optional) – For select candidates, a discussion focused on long\-term growth and strategic alignment.


**Where We Work**
 We believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration, speed, and trust come alive when teams share the same space.
   

  

 With this belief, we operate as a work\-from\-office organization. This role is based out of our
 **Mumbai office** 
 , where innovation happens every day through close collaboration and shared ownership.
   

  

**Perks That Empower You**
 We believe great people deserve great experiences.
   

  

* Design Your Own Benefits: Flexible perks to support your lifestyle.
* Unlimited Wellness Leaves: Take the time you need to rest and recharge.
* Mental Wellness Support: Access to therapy and wellness resources.
* Learning Sessions: Regular learning opportunities to help you grow personally and professionally.


**Ready to Build What's Next?**
 If you're excited about creating reliable technology experiences, solving meaningful technical challenges, and enabling teams to do their best work, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

 Join CoinDCX and help us build the technology that powers the future of finance.

title: Manager, IT Infrastructure & Operations (Individual Contributor)
description:
**About the company** 




 TRYST is a research\-to\-translation institution on the IIT Bombay campus, working across semiconductors, AI, health and bio, energy and clean technology, and related verticals. It is building the digital and IT environment for a multi\-Centre organisation that is expected to scale toward 1,000\+ people, while remaining on campus and partnering with IIT Bombay shared services.
 



 This is a founding IT role: the opportunity to design and run the function, not to inherit one.
 



  





**JOB PURPOSE** 




 Own TRYST’s IT infrastructure and day\-to\-day IT operations — identity and endpoint operations on Microsoft 365 / Entra ID, TRYST cloud and overlay connectivity, devices, backups, and first\-line service.
 



 Build the function from a standing start: standards, vendors, assets and the first hires. Do the work yourself until there is a team. Coordinate campus network, licensed software and journal access with the IIT Bombay Computing Centre rather than recreating those services. Grow the role into Head of Infrastructure as TRYST scales.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




 Note : It's an Individual Contributor role initially and based on Org. requirements , the team can be aligned later.
 



**Infrastructure, cloud and campus overlay** 



* Design, implement and operate TRYST\-owned infrastructure: Microsoft 365 / Entra ID, the endpoint estate, file and backup services, TRYST cloud (Azure as the starting tenancy), and overlay connectivity on the campus network.
* Partner with the IIT Bombay Computing Centre on campus LAN/Wi\-Fi, research computing, and software / journal catalogues. Own the TRYST overlay, the join path for a new employee, and the escalation path to Computing Centre.
* Set infrastructure standards and runbooks that will still hold as TRYST grows across Centres and toward 1,000\+ people, on a common identity and device baseline.
* Plan capacity, backup and disaster recovery for TRYST\-owned systems. Campus backbone DR remains with Computing Centre.



**Identity, endpoint and security operations** 



* Operate Microsoft 365 / Entra ID as TRYST’s directory: account hygiene, groups, MFA, conditional access, privileged access, and the joiner / mover / leaver path from the HR system (Keka).
* Own endpoint management and protection (Intune or equivalent, disk encryption, patching and baseline hardening). TRYST handles research IP; unmanaged devices are not the default.
* Own infrastructure security for TRYST\-run systems: access, backups, incident first\-response, and the first set of IT security policies with the CEO.
* Keep security usable. Default access should follow the employee’s role; exceptions should be the minority.



**Service delivery** 



* Provide IT support until a dedicated service desk exists: provisioning, workstation and access issues, with a published response target.
* Establish a single, simple request channel and evolve it as headcount grows.
* Support lab, compute and connectivity needs of research Centres, escalating specialised research computing to Computing Centre or an agreed cloud pattern.



**Vendors, assets and budget** 



* Own vendor relationships for devices, connectivity overlays, cloud, endpoint security and any managed\-service overflow.
* Maintain the IT asset register and lifecycle — issue, recover, wipe and recycle — tied to joining and leaving.
* Manage the infrastructure and endpoint budget and provide actuals for TRYST IT cost planning.



**Team and operating model** 



* Hire, coach and oversee the first support and infrastructure engineers as workload justifies it.
* Clarify ownership between TRYST IT, HR, Finance and Computing Centre, including where a service is TRYST\-owned, outsourced, or provided by IIT Bombay.
* Leave the organisation able to add a Head of IT, an applications lead and a security lead as TRYST scales, without rewiring this job.



  





**EXPERIENCE** 




**Required** 




 8–12 years in IT infrastructure, systems, network or workplace/endpoint engineering, with end\-to\-end ownership rather than ticket\-only support.
 



 • Hands\-on with cloud identity and modern workplace (Microsoft 365 / Entra ID or a close equivalent): directory, MFA and device management — not only on\-premises Active Directory.
 



 • Experience designing and operating network, server/cloud and backup/disaster\-recovery environments.
 



 • Vendor, contract and budget management. Experience hiring or coaching at least one engineer.
 



 • Comfortable remaining hands\-on — imaging a laptop, resolving connectivity issues, supporting a joiner — as well as designing the environment.
 



  





**Preferred** 




 Built infrastructure for a growing organisation rather than only running a mature one.
 



 • Campus, academic, research\-lab or institutional environments, especially coordinating with a central computing or network group you do not control.
 



 • Identity lifecycle (joiner, mover, leaver) with an HR system such as Keka.
 



 • Familiarity with Indian vendor and procurement practice, and with Mumbai / IIT campus context.
 



  





**WHAT WE LOOK FOR** 



* High tolerance for ambiguity: standards will be written here, not inherited.
* Judgement that balances security, reliability and pace — research IP on one side, an early\-stage timetable on the other.
* Credibility with scientists, operators and vendors, and the ability to hold a single TRYST IT stack rather than parallel Centre\-level ones.
* A bias to hands\-on execution in the first year, with the systems thinking so the second year is not a rewrite.
